## File: src/cash/bank.ts

```ts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import {
  ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError, type BankLine, type BankStatement, type Id, type LedgerEntry, type Repositories,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { financeConfig } from "../config";
import { balanceOf, ledgerId, line, post } from "../posting";
import { lockDateFor } from "../periods/locks";
import { addDays, applyBp, istDay, startOfIstDay } from "../util";

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ CSV parsing

/** RFC 4180 CSV → rows of fields (quotes, doubled quotes, CR/LF). */
export function parseCsv(text: string): string[][] {
  const rows: string[][] = [];
  let row: string[] = [];
  let field = "";
  let quoted = false;
  const s = text.replace(/^﻿/, "");
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const c = s[i]!;
    if (quoted) {
      if (c === '"' && s[i + 1] === '"') { field += '"'; i++; }
      else if (c === '"') quoted = false;
      else field += c;
    } else if (c === '"') quoted = true;
    else if (c === ",") { row.push(field); field = ""; }
    else if (c === "\n" || c === "\r") {
      if (c === "\r" && s[i + 1] === "\n") i++;
      row.push(field); rows.push(row); row = []; field = "";
    } else field += c;
  }
  if (field || row.length) { row.push(field); rows.push(row); }
  return rows.filter((r) => r.some((f) => f.trim() !== ""));
}

/** "1,23,456.78" / "(12.50)" / "12.50 Dr" → paise (string arithmetic, no floats). null when empty. */
export function parseAmount(raw: string | undefined): number | null {
  if (raw === undefined) return null;
  let s = raw.replace(/[,\s]|INR|Rs\.?|₹/gi, "");
  if (!s || s === "-") return null;
  let sign = 1;
  if (/^\(.*\)$/.test(s)) { sign = -1; s = s.slice(1, -1); }
  if (/dr$/i.test(s)) { sign = -sign; s = s.slice(0, -2); } else if (/cr$/i.test(s)) s = s.slice(0, -2);
  if (s.startsWith("-")) { sign = -sign; s = s.slice(1); } else if (s.startsWith("+")) s = s.slice(1);
  const m = /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d{1,2}))?$/.exec(s);
  if (!m) throw new ValidationError(`Not an amount: "${raw}"`);
  return sign * (Number(m[1]) * 100 + Number((m[2] ?? "").padEnd(2, "0")));
}

const MONTHS: Record<string, number> = { jan: 1, feb: 2, mar: 3, apr: 4, may: 5, jun: 6, jul: 7, aug: 8, sep: 9, oct: 10, nov: 11, dec: 12 };

/** "14/10/2026", "14-10-26", "14.10.2026", "2026-10-14", "14-Oct-2026", "14 Oct 2026" → IST day. Indian banks write day first. */
export function parseDay(raw: string): string {
  const s = raw.trim();
  let y: number, m: number, d: number;
  let r: RegExpExecArray | null;
  if ((r = /^(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})/.exec(s))) [y, m, d] = [Number(r[1]), Number(r[2]), Number(r[3])];
  else if ((r = /^(\d{1,2})[/.-](\d{1,2})[/.-](\d{2,4})$/.exec(s))) [d, m, y] = [Number(r[1]), Number(r[2]), Number(r[3])];
  else if ((r = /^(\d{1,2})[\s/-]([A-Za-z]{3})[A-Za-z]*[\s/-](\d{2,4})$/.exec(s)) && MONTHS[r[2]!.toLowerCase()]) [d, m, y] = [Number(r[1]), MONTHS[r[2]!.toLowerCase()]!, Number(r[3])];
  else throw new ValidationError(`Not a date: "${raw}"`);
  if (y < 100) y += 2000;
  const day = `${y}-${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(d).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  startOfIstDay(day); // validates
  return day;
}

export interface ParsedBankLine {
  day: string;
  description: string;
  reference?: string;
  debitPaise: number;
  creditPaise: number;
  balancePaise?: number | null;
}

const HEADERS = {
  date: ["txn date", "transaction date", "tran date", "date", "value date", "posting date"],
  description: ["description", "narration", "particulars", "remarks", "transaction details", "details"],
  reference: ["chq/ref no", "chq./ref.no.", "ref no", "reference", "reference no", "cheque no", "chq no", "utr", "utr no"],
  debit: ["debit", "withdrawal", "withdrawal amt", "withdrawals", "debit amount", "dr"],
  credit: ["credit", "deposit", "deposit amt", "deposits", "credit amount", "cr"],
  amount: ["amount", "transaction amount"],
  type: ["type", "dr/cr", "cr/dr", "debit/credit"],
  balance: ["balance", "closing balance", "running balance", "available balance"],
};
type Col = keyof typeof HEADERS;
const norm = (h: string) => h.toLowerCase().replace(/\(.*?\)/g, "").replace(/\./g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

/**
 * Reads a bank statement CSV. Finds the header row (skipping bank preamble lines), then the columns by
 * their usual names: date, description, reference, debit/credit (or amount + Dr/Cr type), balance.
 * Pass `columns` to name them yourself.
 */
export function parseBankCsv(text: string, columns?: Partial<Record<Col, string>>): ParsedBankLine[] {
  const rows = parseCsv(text);
  const find = (header: string[]): Partial<Record<Col, number>> => {
    const h = header.map(norm);
    const out: Partial<Record<Col, number>> = {};
    for (const col of Object.keys(HEADERS) as Col[]) {
      const names = (columns?.[col] ? [columns[col]!] : HEADERS[col]).map(norm);
      for (const n of names) {
        const i = h.indexOf(n);
        if (i >= 0 && !Object.values(out).includes(i)) { out[col] = i; break; }
      }
    }
    return out;
  };
  const headerAt = rows.findIndex((r) => {
    const c = find(r);
    return c.date !== undefined && (c.debit !== undefined || c.credit !== undefined || c.amount !== undefined);
  });
  if (headerAt < 0) throw new ValidationError("No header row with a date and debit/credit (or amount) columns");
  const c = find(rows[headerAt]!);
  const out: ParsedBankLine[] = [];
  for (const r of rows.slice(headerAt + 1)) {
    const dateCell = r[c.date!]?.trim();
    if (!dateCell || !/\d/.test(dateCell)) continue; // totals / footer lines
    let debit = c.debit !== undefined ? parseAmount(r[c.debit]) ?? 0 : 0;
    let credit = c.credit !== undefined ? parseAmount(r[c.credit]) ?? 0 : 0;
    if (c.amount !== undefined && c.debit === undefined && c.credit === undefined) {
      const amt = parseAmount(r[c.amount]) ?? 0;
      const t = c.type !== undefined ? r[c.type]!.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
      if (t.startsWith("d")) debit = Math.abs(amt);
      else if (t.startsWith("c")) credit = Math.abs(amt);
      else if (amt < 0) debit = -amt;
      else credit = amt;
    }
    if (debit < 0 || credit < 0) [debit, credit] = [Math.max(0, -credit, debit), Math.max(0, -debit, credit)];
    if (debit === 0 && credit === 0) continue;
    if (debit > 0 && credit > 0) throw new ValidationError(`A line has both a debit and a credit: ${r.join(",")}`);
    out.push({
      day: parseDay(dateCell), description: (c.description !== undefined ? r[c.description] ?? "" : "").trim(),
      reference: c.reference !== undefined ? r[c.reference]?.trim() || undefined : undefined,
      debitPaise: debit, creditPaise: credit, balancePaise: c.balance !== undefined ? parseAmount(r[c.balance]) : null,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ import

/** Same day: by reference, description and amount, so matching does not depend on ids or storage order. */
function byStatementOrder(a: BankLine, b: BankLine): number {
  return a.date.getTime() - b.date.getTime() || (a.reference ?? "").localeCompare(b.reference ?? "") || a.description.localeCompare(b.description)
    || a.creditPaise - b.creditPaise || a.debitPaise - b.debitPaise || a.dedupKey.localeCompare(b.dedupKey);
}

export interface ImportInput {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  /** The bank ledger (e.g. system key "bank"). */
  ledgerId: Id;
  fileName?: string;
  csv?: string;
  lines?: ParsedBankLine[];
}

/**
 * Stores a statement and its lines. Each line gets a dedup key (ledger, day, amounts, reference,
 * description, and its occurrence number in the file), so importing the same file again adds nothing.
 */
export async function importBankStatement(repos: Repositories, input: ImportInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<{ statement: BankStatement; added: number; skipped: number }> {
  const lines = input.lines ?? (input.csv !== undefined ? parseBankCsv(input.csv) : []);
  if (!lines.length) throw new ValidationError("The statement has no lines");
  const seen = new Map<string, number>();
  const keyed = lines.map((l) => {
    const base = [input.ledgerId, l.day, l.debitPaise, l.creditPaise, l.reference ?? "", l.description].join("|");
    const n = (seen.get(base) ?? 0) + 1;
    seen.set(base, n);
    return { ...l, dedupKey: createHash("sha256").update(`${base}|${n}`).digest("hex") };
  });
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const ledger = await tx.ledgers.get(input.ledgerId);
    if (!ledger || ledger.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger", input.ledgerId);
    const days = keyed.map((l) => l.day).sort();
    const withBalance = keyed.filter((l) => l.balancePaise != null);
    const statement = await tx.bankStatements.create({
      orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, ledgerId: input.ledgerId, fileName: input.fileName, from: startOfIstDay(days[0]!), to: startOfIstDay(days.at(-1)!),
      openingPaise: withBalance.length ? withBalance[0]!.balancePaise! - withBalance[0]!.creditPaise + withBalance[0]!.debitPaise : null,
      closingPaise: withBalance.length ? withBalance.at(-1)!.balancePaise! : null, lineCount: keyed.length, importedBy: actorId ?? null,
    });
    let added = 0;
    for (const l of keyed) {
      if (await tx.bankLines.findOne({ orgId: input.orgId, dedupKey: l.dedupKey })) continue;
      await tx.bankLines.create({
        orgId: input.orgId, statementId: statement.id, ledgerId: input.ledgerId, date: startOfIstDay(l.day), description: l.description, reference: l.reference,
        debitPaise: l.debitPaise, creditPaise: l.creditPaise, balancePaise: l.balancePaise ?? null, dedupKey: l.dedupKey, status: "unmatched", voucherIds: [],
      });
      added++;
    }
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.bank.import", entity: "bank_statement", entityId: statement.id, data: { added, skipped: keyed.length - added } });
    return { statement, added, skipped: keyed.length - added };
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ matching

const lineDay = (l: Pick<BankLine, "date">) => istDay(l.date);
const dist = (a: string, b: string) => Math.abs((startOfIstDay(a).getTime() - startOfIstDay(b).getTime()) / 86400000);

/** Voucher ids already matched to some bank line of this ledger. */
async function matchedVoucherIds(repos: Repositories, ledgerId: Id): Promise<Set<Id>> {
  const lines = await repos.bankLines.find({ ledgerId, status: "matched" });
  return new Set(lines.flatMap((l) => l.voucherIds));
}

/**
 * Matches unmatched bank lines with the books, in one transaction:
 * 1. **Entries:** a line equal to one posting on the bank ledger (credit ↔ debit, debit ↔ credit),
 *    dated within `toleranceDays`, not matched before; the reference in the narration wins, then
 *    the nearest date.
 * 2. **Card / UPI settlements:** a bank credit that equals one day's net receipts on a clearing
 *    ledger (UPI Collections, Card Settlements) less a fee of at most `maxFeeBp`. It posts a Contra:
 *    Dr Bank (amount), Dr Bank Charges (fee), Cr the clearing ledger (gross), and matches it.
 */
export async function reconcileBank(repos: Repositories, input: { orgId: Id; ledgerId: Id; statementId?: Id }, actorId?: Id) {
  const cfg = await financeConfig(repos, input.orgId);
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const lines = (await tx.bankLines.find({ ledgerId: input.ledgerId, status: "unmatched", ...(input.statementId ? { statementId: input.statementId } : {}) }))
      .filter((l) => l.orgId === input.orgId)
      .sort(byStatementOrder);
    if (!lines.length) return { matched: 0, settlements: 0, unmatched: 0 };
    const used = await matchedVoucherIds(tx, input.ledgerId);
    const first = addDays(lineDay(lines[0]!), -cfg.bank.toleranceDays - 7);
    const last = addDays(lineDay(lines.at(-1)!), cfg.bank.toleranceDays);
    const window = { orgId: input.orgId, from: startOfIstDay(first), to: startOfIstDay(addDays(last, 1)) };
    const book = await tx.ledgerEntries.list({ ...window, ledgerId: input.ledgerId });
    const narrations = new Map<Id, string>();
    const narration = async (voucherId: Id) => {
      if (!narrations.has(voucherId)) narrations.set(voucherId, (await tx.vouchers.get(voucherId))?.narration ?? "");
      return narrations.get(voucherId)!;
    };

    // clearing ledgers: net receipts per IST day, and the days already settled
    const clearing = [];
    for (const key of cfg.bank.clearingLedgerKeys) {
      const l = await tx.ledgers.findBySystemKey(input.orgId, key);
      if (!l) continue;
      const entries = await tx.ledgerEntries.list({ ...window, ledgerId: l.id });
      const daily = new Map<string, number>();
      for (const e of entries) if (e.voucherType !== "contra") daily.set(istDay(e.date), (daily.get(istDay(e.date)) ?? 0) + e.debitPaise - e.creditPaise);
      clearing.push({ ledgerId: l.id, daily });
    }
    const settled = new Set((await tx.bankLines.find({ ledgerId: input.ledgerId, status: "matched", matchKind: "settlement" })).map((l) => `${l.settlement!.ledgerId}|${l.settlement!.day}`));
    const charges = await ledgerId(tx, input.orgId, "bank_charges");

    let matched = 0;
    let settlements = 0;
    for (const bl of lines) {
      const day = lineDay(bl);
      const amount = bl.creditPaise || bl.debitPaise;
      const candidates: LedgerEntry[] = book.filter((e) =>
        !used.has(e.voucherId) && (bl.creditPaise ? e.debitPaise === amount : e.creditPaise === amount) && dist(istDay(e.date), day) <= cfg.bank.toleranceDays);
      if (candidates.length) {
        const ref = bl.reference?.toLowerCase();
        const scored = await Promise.all(candidates.map(async (e) => ({ e, hit: Boolean(ref && (await narration(e.voucherId)).toLowerCase().includes(ref)), d: dist(istDay(e.date), day) })));
        scored.sort((a, b) => Number(b.hit) - Number(a.hit) || a.d - b.d || a.e.voucherNo.localeCompare(b.e.voucherNo));
        const pick = scored[0]!.e;
        used.add(pick.voucherId);
        await tx.bankLines.update(bl.id, { status: "matched", matchKind: "entry", voucherIds: [pick.voucherId], matchedBy: actorId ?? null, matchedAt: new Date() });
        matched++;
        continue;
      }
      if (!bl.creditPaise) continue;
      // settlement of an earlier day's card / UPI receipts, net of the fee
      let found: { ledgerId: Id; day: string; gross: number } | undefined;
      for (let back = 0; back <= cfg.bank.toleranceDays + 7 && !found; back++) {
        const d = addDays(day, -back);
        for (const c of clearing) {
          const gross = c.daily.get(d) ?? 0;
          const fee = gross - bl.creditPaise;
          if (gross > 0 && !settled.has(`${c.ledgerId}|${d}`) && fee >= 0 && fee <= applyBp(gross, cfg.bank.maxFeeBp)) { found = { ledgerId: c.ledgerId, day: d, gross }; break; }
        }
      }
      if (!found) continue;
      const fee = found.gross - bl.creditPaise;
      const statement = await tx.bankStatements.get(bl.statementId);
      // dated the bank's day; if that day is already locked (e.g. its cash is closed), the first open instant
      const lock = await lockDateFor(tx, input.orgId, statement!.branchId);
      const date = !lock || bl.date.getTime() > lock.getTime() ? bl.date : new Date(Math.max(Date.now(), lock.getTime() + 1));
      const voucher = await post(tx, {
        orgId: input.orgId, branchId: statement!.branchId, type: "contra", date,
        narration: `Settlement of ${found.day} receipts${bl.reference ? ` ref ${bl.reference}` : ""}: gross ${found.gross}, fee ${fee} paise`,
        entries: [line(input.ledgerId, bl.creditPaise), line(charges, fee), line(found.ledgerId, -found.gross)].filter((e) => e.debitPaise > 0 || e.creditPaise > 0),
      }, actorId);
      settled.add(`${found.ledgerId}|${found.day}`);
      used.add(voucher.id);
      await tx.bankLines.update(bl.id, {
        status: "matched", matchKind: "settlement", voucherIds: [voucher.id], settlement: { ledgerId: found.ledgerId, day: found.day, grossPaise: found.gross, feePaise: fee },
        matchedBy: actorId ?? null, matchedAt: new Date(),
      });
      settlements++;
    }
    return { matched, settlements, unmatched: lines.length - matched - settlements };
  });
}

/** Matches a line by hand with vouchers whose postings on the bank ledger add up to the line. */
export async function matchBankLine(repos: Repositories, input: { orgId: Id; lineId: Id; voucherIds: Id[] }, actorId?: Id): Promise<BankLine> {
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const bl = await tx.bankLines.get(input.lineId);
    if (!bl || bl.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Bank line", input.lineId);
    if (bl.status === "matched") throw new ConflictError("The line is already matched");
    const used = await matchedVoucherIds(tx, bl.ledgerId);
    let net = 0;
    for (const id of input.voucherIds) {
      if (used.has(id)) throw new ConflictError(`Voucher ${id} is already matched`);
      const v = await tx.vouchers.get(id);
      if (!v || v.orgId !== input.orgId || v.status !== "posted") throw new NotFoundError("Posted voucher", id);
      for (const e of v.entries) if (e.ledgerId === bl.ledgerId) net += e.debitPaise - e.creditPaise;
    }
    if (net !== bl.creditPaise - bl.debitPaise) throw new ValidationError(`The vouchers move ${net} paise on the bank ledger; the line is ${bl.creditPaise - bl.debitPaise}`);
    return (await tx.bankLines.update(bl.id, { status: "matched", matchKind: "manual", voucherIds: input.voucherIds, matchedBy: actorId ?? null, matchedAt: new Date() }))!;
  });
}

/** Marks a line as not needing a match (e.g. a reversal pair), or undoes a manual / entry match. */
export async function setBankLineStatus(repos: Repositories, input: { orgId: Id; lineId: Id; status: "ignored" | "unmatched" }, actorId?: Id): Promise<BankLine> {
  const bl = await repos.bankLines.get(input.lineId);
  if (!bl || bl.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Bank line", input.lineId);
  if (bl.matchKind === "settlement") throw new ConflictError("A settlement match posted a voucher: cancel it before unmatching");
  return (await repos.bankLines.update(bl.id, { status: input.status, matchKind: null, voucherIds: [], matchedBy: actorId ?? null, matchedAt: input.status === "ignored" ? new Date() : null }))!;
}

/**
 * Bank reconciliation statement at a date:
 *   balance per bank = balance per books + payments not yet presented − deposits not yet credited
 *                      + bank credits not in the books − bank debits not in the books
 * `differencePaise` is 0 when everything is explained (needs balances in the statement).
 */
export async function bankReconciliation(repos: Repositories, q: { orgId: Id; ledgerId: Id; asOf: Date }) {
  const lines = (await repos.bankLines.find({ ledgerId: q.ledgerId })).filter((l) => l.orgId === q.orgId && l.date.getTime() <= q.asOf.getTime());
  lines.sort(byStatementOrder);
  const matched = new Set(lines.filter((l) => l.status === "matched").flatMap((l) => l.voucherIds));
  const entries = await repos.ledgerEntries.list({ orgId: q.orgId, ledgerId: q.ledgerId, to: q.asOf });
  const unreconciled = entries.filter((e) => !matched.has(e.voucherId));
  const bookPaise = await balanceOf(repos, { orgId: q.orgId, ledgerId: q.ledgerId, asOf: q.asOf });
  const withBalance = lines.filter((l) => l.balancePaise != null);
  const bankPaise = withBalance.length ? withBalance.at(-1)!.balancePaise! : null;
  const open = lines.filter((l) => l.status === "unmatched");
  const sum = (xs: number[]) => xs.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0);
  const notPresented = sum(unreconciled.map((e) => e.creditPaise));
  const notCredited = sum(unreconciled.map((e) => e.debitPaise));
  const bankCredits = sum(open.map((l) => l.creditPaise));
  const bankDebits = sum(open.map((l) => l.debitPaise));
  const expected = bookPaise + notPresented - notCredited + bankCredits - bankDebits;
  return {
    bookPaise,
    bankPaise,
    paymentsNotPresentedPaise: notPresented,
    depositsNotCreditedPaise: notCredited,
    bankCreditsNotInBooksPaise: bankCredits,
    bankDebitsNotInBooksPaise: bankDebits,
    expectedBankPaise: expected,
    differencePaise: bankPaise === null ? null : bankPaise - expected,
    reconciled: { lines: lines.filter((l) => l.status === "matched").length, amountPaise: sum(lines.filter((l) => l.status === "matched").map((l) => l.creditPaise - l.debitPaise)) },
    unmatchedLines: open,
    unreconciledEntries: unreconciled,
  };
}
```

## File: src/cash/closing.ts

```ts
import { ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError, type CashClosing, type CashDenomination, type Id, type Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { balanceOf, ledgerIds, line, post } from "../posting";
import { assertDay, endOfIstDay } from "../util";

export interface CashClosingInput {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  /** IST day being closed, "2026-10-14". */
  day: string;
  countedPaise: number;
  /** Notes and coins counted; must add up to countedPaise. */
  denominations?: CashDenomination[];
  notes?: string;
}

/**
 * Day-end cash closing for a branch, in one transaction:
 * 1. takes the branch's lock row exclusively, so no posting can land while the cash is counted;
 * 2. book balance = the branch's postings on the Cash ledger up to the end of the day;
 * 3. a difference posts a Journal at 23:59:59.999 IST: short → Dr Cash Short / Excess, Cr Cash;
 *    excess → Dr Cash, Cr Cash Short / Excess;
 * 4. the branch's lock date moves to the end of that day: the closed day rejects new postings.
 * Days close in order; a day on or before the branch's lock date cannot be closed again.
 */
export async function closeCashDay(repos: Repositories, input: CashClosingInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<CashClosing> {
  assertDay(input.day);
  if (!(Number.isSafeInteger(input.countedPaise) && input.countedPaise >= 0)) throw new ValidationError("countedPaise must be whole paise ≥ 0");
  if (input.denominations) {
    for (const d of input.denominations) if (!(Number.isSafeInteger(d.valuePaise) && d.valuePaise > 0 && Number.isInteger(d.count) && d.count >= 0)) throw new ValidationError("Bad denomination");
    const counted = input.denominations.reduce((s, d) => s + d.valuePaise * d.count, 0);
    if (counted !== input.countedPaise) throw new ValidationError(`Denominations add up to ${counted} paise, not ${input.countedPaise}`);
  }
  const end = endOfIstDay(input.day);
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const branch = await tx.branches.get(input.branchId);
    if (!branch || branch.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Branch", input.branchId);
    const [lock] = await tx.periodLocks.hold(input.orgId, [input.branchId], "update");
    if (lock!.lockedUpTo && lock!.lockedUpTo.getTime() >= end.getTime()) throw new ConflictError(`${branch.code} is closed up to ${lock!.lockedUpTo.toISOString()}; ${input.day} cannot be closed again`);
    if (await tx.cashClosings.findOne({ orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, day: input.day })) throw new ConflictError(`${input.day} is already closed for ${branch.code}`);
    const k = await ledgerIds(tx, input.orgId, ["cash", "cash_short_excess"] as const);
    const book = await balanceOf(tx, { orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, ledgerId: k.cash, asOf: end });
    const diff = input.countedPaise - book;
    const voucher = diff === 0 ? null : await post(tx, {
      orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, type: "journal", date: end,
      narration: `Cash ${diff < 0 ? "short" : "excess"} at day-end ${input.day} (book ${book}, counted ${input.countedPaise} paise)`,
      entries: [line(k.cash, diff), line(k.cash_short_excess, -diff)],
    }, actorId);
    const closing = await tx.cashClosings.create({
      orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, day: input.day, bookPaise: book, countedPaise: input.countedPaise, differencePaise: diff,
      denominations: input.denominations, voucherId: voucher?.id ?? null, closedBy: actorId ?? null, notes: input.notes,
    });
    await tx.periodLocks.update(lock!.id, { lockedUpTo: end, reason: `cash closed ${input.day}`, updatedBy: actorId ?? null });
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.cash.close", entity: "cash_closing", entityId: closing.id, data: { day: input.day, bookPaise: book, countedPaise: input.countedPaise } });
    return closing;
  });
}
```

## File: src/config.ts

```ts
import type { ItemCategory, Repositories, Taxability } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";

/**
 * Compliance values are CONFIGURATION, not legal advice. Every value below marked "verify with CA"
 * must be confirmed by the lab's chartered accountant before use (see docs/gst-notes.md).
 * An organisation overrides them in `organization.settings.finance` (merged over these defaults).
 */

export interface TdsConfig {
  /** Section label printed on statements, e.g. "194H". Verify with CA. */
  section: string;
  /** Rate in basis points (200 = 2%). Verify with CA. */
  rateBp: number;
  /** Rate when the partner has no PAN on record, in basis points. Verify with CA. */
  noPanRateBp: number;
  /** TDS applies once a partner's shares in the financial year exceed this (null = always). Verify with CA. */
  thresholdPaise: number | null;
}

export interface FinanceConfig {
  gst: {
    /** GSTR-1 B2C Large: inter-state invoices to unregistered buyers above this value. Verify with CA. */
    b2clThresholdPaise: number;
  };
  /** Default TDS on partner shares; a partner's own `tds` overrides section and rate. */
  tds: TdsConfig;
  bank: {
    /** How far apart (days) a bank line and its book entry may be dated. */
    toleranceDays: number;
    /** Card / UPI settlements: the largest fee (MDR) accepted, in basis points of the gross. */
    maxFeeBp: number;
    /** Clearing ledgers settled into the bank net of fees (db-kit system keys). */
    clearingLedgerKeys: string[];
  };
}

export const DEFAULT_FINANCE_CONFIG: FinanceConfig = {
  gst: { b2clThresholdPaise: 100_000_00 },
  tds: { section: "194H", rateBp: 200, noPanRateBp: 2000, thresholdPaise: 20_000_00 },
  bank: { toleranceDays: 3, maxFeeBp: 300, clearingLedgerKeys: ["upi", "card"] },
};

/** The values the lab's CA must confirm. Shown in docs and returned with every GST/TDS report. */
export const VERIFY_WITH_CA = [
  "GST taxability, SAC/HSN and rates of every item category and code (tax rules)",
  "Place of supply for diagnostic services and goods (CGST+SGST vs IGST)",
  "GSTR-1 B2C Large threshold",
  "TDS section, rate, no-PAN rate, threshold and rounding on partner shares",
  "GST on partner shares (not charged in this version)",
] as const;

export interface TaxRuleDef {
  code?: string | null;
  category?: ItemCategory | null;
  hsnSac: string;
  taxability: Taxability;
  ratePercent: number;
  effectiveFrom: string;
  note?: string;
}

/**
 * Starting rules, seeded by seedTaxRules. Verify with CA.
 * Diagnostic services by a clinical establishment are generally exempt; consumables and medicines
 * have no category default on purpose: each item code needs its own HSN and rate rule, and
 * applyTaxRules refuses a code without one.
 */
export const DEFAULT_TAX_RULES: TaxRuleDef[] = [
  { category: "test", hsnSac: "999316", taxability: "exempt", ratePercent: 0, effectiveFrom: "2017-07-01", note: "Diagnostic services by a clinical establishment. Verify with CA." },
  { category: "package", hsnSac: "999316", taxability: "exempt", ratePercent: 0, effectiveFrom: "2017-07-01", note: "Health packages of diagnostic tests. Verify with CA." },
  { category: "service", hsnSac: "999316", taxability: "exempt", ratePercent: 0, effectiveFrom: "2017-07-01", note: "Home collection and other lab services. Verify with CA." },
];

type DeepPartial<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: T[K] extends object ? (T[K] extends unknown[] ? T[K] : DeepPartial<T[K]>) : T[K] };
export type FinanceSettings = DeepPartial<FinanceConfig>;

export function mergeConfig(over: FinanceSettings = {}): FinanceConfig {
  const d = DEFAULT_FINANCE_CONFIG;
  return {
    gst: { ...d.gst, ...over.gst },
    tds: { ...d.tds, ...over.tds },
    bank: { ...d.bank, ...over.bank, clearingLedgerKeys: over.bank?.clearingLedgerKeys ?? d.bank.clearingLedgerKeys },
  } as FinanceConfig;
}

/** The organisation's finance configuration: `settings.finance` over the defaults. */
export async function financeConfig(repos: Repositories, orgId: string): Promise<FinanceConfig> {
  const org = await repos.orgs.get(orgId);
  return mergeConfig((org?.settings?.finance ?? {}) as FinanceSettings);
}
```

## File: src/export/books.ts

```ts
import { NotFoundError, type Id, type Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { balanceSheet, dayBook, ledgerStatement, profitAndLoss, trialBalance } from "../posting";
import { istDay } from "../util";
import { rupees, toCsv } from "./csv";

/**
 * Books exports. Each one ends with a TOTAL row equal to the report it comes from (tests check it).
 */

interface Range {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId?: Id;
  from: Date;
  to: Date;
}

/** Day book: one row per voucher line; cancelled vouchers are listed with their status and left out of the totals. */
export async function dayBookCsv(repos: Repositories, q: Range & { bom?: boolean }): Promise<string> {
  const vouchers = await dayBook(repos, q);
  const names = new Map((await repos.ledgers.find({ orgId: q.orgId })).map((l) => [l.id, l.name]));
  let dr = 0;
  let cr = 0;
  const rows = vouchers.flatMap((v) => v.entries.map((e) => {
    if (v.status === "posted") { dr += e.debitPaise; cr += e.creditPaise; }
    return [istDay(v.date), v.voucherNo, v.type, v.status, names.get(e.ledgerId) ?? e.ledgerId, rupees(e.debitPaise, true), rupees(e.creditPaise, true), v.narration ?? ""];
  }));
  rows.push(["", "", "", "", "TOTAL (posted)", rupees(dr), rupees(cr), ""]);
  return toCsv(["Date", "Voucher No", "Type", "Status", "Ledger", "Debit", "Credit", "Narration"], rows, q);
}

/** A ledger account: opening, every posting with running balance (Dr / Cr), closing. */
export async function ledgerCsv(repos: Repositories, q: Range & { ledgerId: Id; bom?: boolean }): Promise<string> {
  const ledger = await repos.ledgers.get(q.ledgerId);
  if (!ledger || ledger.orgId !== q.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger", q.ledgerId);
  const s = await ledgerStatement(repos, q);
  const side = (p: number) => (p === 0 ? "" : p > 0 ? "Dr" : "Cr");
  const rows = [
    ["", "", "Opening balance", "", "", rupees(Math.abs(s.openingPaise)), side(s.openingPaise)],
    ...s.rows.map((r) => [istDay(r.date), r.voucherNo, r.voucherType, rupees(r.debitPaise, true), rupees(r.creditPaise, true), rupees(Math.abs(r.balancePaise)), side(r.balancePaise)]),
    ["", "", "TOTAL", rupees(s.totalDebitPaise), rupees(s.totalCreditPaise), "", ""],
    ["", "", "Closing balance", "", "", rupees(Math.abs(s.closingPaise)), side(s.closingPaise)],
  ];
  return toCsv([`Ledger: ${s.ledger.name}`, "Voucher No", "Type", "Debit", "Credit", "Balance", "Dr/Cr"], rows, q);
}

export async function trialBalanceCsv(repos: Repositories, q: { orgId: Id; branchId?: Id; asOf?: Date; bom?: boolean }): Promise<string> {
  const tb = await trialBalance(repos, q);
  const rows = tb.rows.map((r) => [r.primaryGroup.name, r.group.name, r.ledger.name, rupees(r.debitPaise, true), rupees(r.creditPaise, true)]);
  rows.push(["", "", "TOTAL", rupees(tb.totalDebitPaise), rupees(tb.totalCreditPaise)]);
  return toCsv(["Primary group", "Group", "Ledger", "Debit", "Credit"], rows, q);
}

export async function profitAndLossCsv(repos: Repositories, q: Range & { bom?: boolean }): Promise<string> {
  const pl = await profitAndLoss(repos, q);
  const rows: string[][] = [];
  for (const [side, lines] of [["Income", pl.income], ["Expenses", pl.expenses]] as const)
    for (const g of [...lines].sort((a, b) => a.group.name.localeCompare(b.group.name)))
      for (const l of [...g.ledgers].sort((a, b) => a.ledger.name.localeCompare(b.ledger.name))) rows.push([side, g.group.name, l.ledger.name, rupees(l.amountPaise)]);
  rows.push(["", "", "Gross profit", rupees(pl.grossProfitPaise)], ["", "", "Net profit", rupees(pl.netProfitPaise)]);
  return toCsv(["Side", "Group", "Ledger", "Amount"], rows, q);
}

export async function balanceSheetCsv(repos: Repositories, q: { orgId: Id; branchId?: Id; asOf: Date; bom?: boolean }): Promise<string> {
  const bs = await balanceSheet(repos, q);
  const rows: string[][] = [];
  for (const [side, lines] of [["Liabilities", bs.liabilities], ["Assets", bs.assets]] as const)
    for (const g of [...lines].sort((a, b) => a.group.name.localeCompare(b.group.name)))
      for (const l of [...g.ledgers].sort((a, b) => a.ledger.name.localeCompare(b.ledger.name))) rows.push([side, g.group.name, l.ledger.name, rupees(l.amountPaise)]);
  rows.push(["Liabilities", "", "Profit to date", rupees(bs.profitPaise)]);
  rows.push(["", "", "TOTAL liabilities", rupees(bs.totalLiabilitiesPaise)], ["", "", "TOTAL assets", rupees(bs.totalAssetsPaise)]);
  return toCsv(["Side", "Group", "Ledger", "Amount"], rows, q);
}

/** A partner's settlement statement. */
export async function settlementCsv(repos: Repositories, q: { orgId: Id; settlementId: Id; bom?: boolean }): Promise<string> {
  const s = await repos.settlements.get(q.settlementId);
  if (!s || s.orgId !== q.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Settlement", q.settlementId);
  const rows: string[][] = s.lines.map((l) => [l.day, l.invoiceNo, l.code ?? "", l.name, rupees(l.netPaise), rupees(l.sharePaise)]);
  rows.push(["", "", "", "TOTAL", rupees(s.grossPaise), rupees(s.sharePaise)]);
  for (const d of s.deductions) rows.push(["", "", "", `Less: ${d.label}`, "", rupees(-d.amountPaise)]);
  rows.push(["", "", "", `Less: TDS ${s.tdsSection ?? ""} @ ${s.tdsRateBp / 100}% on ${rupees(s.tdsBasePaise)}`, "", rupees(-s.tdsPaise)]);
  rows.push(["", "", "", "NET PAYABLE", "", rupees(s.netPaise)]);
  return toCsv(["Date", "Invoice No", "Code", "Test", "Net billed", "Share"], rows, q);
}
```

## File: src/export/csv.ts

```ts
/**
 * CSV for the CA: RFC 4180 (CRLF, quoted when needed), UTF-8. Amounts are rupees with two decimals
 * written from integer paise (no floats); dates are IST days "YYYY-MM-DD". Our own formats, no Tally XML.
 */

export type Cell = string | number | null | undefined;

const quote = (v: Cell): string => {
  const s = v === null || v === undefined ? "" : String(v);
  return /[",\r\n]/.test(s) || /^\s|\s$/.test(s) ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s;
};

/** Rows → CSV text. Pass `bom: true` for Excel on Windows to read UTF-8. */
export function toCsv(header: string[], rows: Cell[][], opts: { bom?: boolean } = {}): string {
  const text = [header, ...rows].map((r) => r.map(quote).join(",")).join("\r\n") + "\r\n";
  return opts.bom ? `﻿${text}` : text;
}

/** 123456 → "1234.56", -5 → "-0.05". Empty for 0 when `blankZero`. */
export function rupees(paise: number, blankZero = false): string {
  if (blankZero && paise === 0) return "";
  const sign = paise < 0 ? "-" : "";
  const a = Math.abs(paise);
  return `${sign}${Math.floor(a / 100)}.${String(a % 100).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

/** GST rate for display: 18 → "18", 0.25 → "0.25". */
export const ratePct = (r: number) => String(r);
```

## File: src/export/gst.ts

```ts
import type { Gstr1 } from "../gst/gstr1";
import type { Gstr3b } from "../gst/gstr3b";
import { ratePct, rupees, toCsv } from "./csv";

/** GSTR-1 sections as CSV files (our own columns, close to the GST offline tool's). Each ends with a TOTAL row. */
export function gstr1Csv(r: Gstr1, opts: { bom?: boolean } = {}): Record<"b2b" | "b2cl" | "b2cs" | "cdnr" | "cdnur" | "nil" | "hsn" | "docs", string> {
  const inv = (rows: (Gstr1["b2cl"][number] & { ctin?: string })[], withCtin: boolean) => {
    const out: string[][] = [];
    const t = [0, 0, 0, 0];
    for (const i of rows) for (const it of i.items) {
      out.push([...(withCtin ? [i.ctin ?? ""] : []), i.invoiceNo, i.day, rupees(i.valuePaise), i.placeOfSupply, ...(withCtin ? [i.reverseCharge] : []), ratePct(it.ratePercent), rupees(it.taxablePaise), rupees(it.igstPaise), rupees(it.cgstPaise), rupees(it.sgstPaise)]);
      t[0]! += it.taxablePaise; t[1]! += it.igstPaise; t[2]! += it.cgstPaise; t[3]! += it.sgstPaise;
    }
    out.push([...(withCtin ? [""] : []), "TOTAL", "", "", "", ...(withCtin ? [""] : []), "", ...t.map((x) => rupees(x))]);
    return out;
  };
  const notes = (rows: (Gstr1["cdnr"][number] | Gstr1["cdnur"][number])[], first: (n: (typeof rows)[number]) => string) => {
    const out: string[][] = [];
    const t = [0, 0, 0, 0];
    for (const n of rows) for (const it of n.items) {
      out.push([first(n), n.noteNo, n.day, n.noteType, n.invoiceNo, n.invoiceDay, rupees(n.valuePaise), n.placeOfSupply, ratePct(it.ratePercent), rupees(it.taxablePaise), rupees(it.igstPaise), rupees(it.cgstPaise), rupees(it.sgstPaise)]);
      t[0]! += it.taxablePaise; t[1]! += it.igstPaise; t[2]! += it.cgstPaise; t[3]! += it.sgstPaise;
    }
    out.push(["", "TOTAL", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ...t.map((x) => rupees(x))]);
    return out;
  };
  const tax = ["Taxable value", "IGST", "CGST", "SGST"];
  const b2csRows = r.b2cs.map((x) => [x.supplyType, x.placeOfSupply, ratePct(x.ratePercent), rupees(x.taxablePaise), rupees(x.igstPaise), rupees(x.cgstPaise), rupees(x.sgstPaise)]);
  const s = (f: (x: Gstr1["b2cs"][number]) => number) => rupees(r.b2cs.reduce((a, x) => a + f(x), 0));
  b2csRows.push(["TOTAL", "", "", s((x) => x.taxablePaise), s((x) => x.igstPaise), s((x) => x.cgstPaise), s((x) => x.sgstPaise)]);
  const nilRows = r.nil.map((x) => [x.description, rupees(x.nilRatedPaise), rupees(x.exemptedPaise), rupees(x.nonGstPaise)]);
  const n = (f: (x: Gstr1["nil"][number]) => number) => rupees(r.nil.reduce((a, x) => a + f(x), 0));
  nilRows.push(["TOTAL", n((x) => x.nilRatedPaise), n((x) => x.exemptedPaise), n((x) => x.nonGstPaise)]);
  const hsnRows: string[][] = [];
  for (const [kind, rows] of [["B2B", r.hsn.b2b], ["B2C", r.hsn.b2c]] as const)
    for (const h of rows) hsnRows.push([kind, h.hsnSac, h.taxability, ratePct(h.ratePercent), String(h.qty), rupees(h.totalValuePaise), rupees(h.taxablePaise), rupees(h.igstPaise), rupees(h.cgstPaise), rupees(h.sgstPaise)]);
  const all = [...r.hsn.b2b, ...r.hsn.b2c];
  const hs = (f: (x: (typeof all)[number]) => number) => rupees(all.reduce((a, x) => a + f(x), 0));
  hsnRows.push(["TOTAL", "", "", "", "", hs((x) => x.totalValuePaise), hs((x) => x.taxablePaise), hs((x) => x.igstPaise), hs((x) => x.cgstPaise), hs((x) => x.sgstPaise)]);
  return {
    b2b: toCsv(["GSTIN of recipient", "Invoice No", "Invoice date", "Invoice value", "Place of supply", "Reverse charge", "Rate", ...tax], inv(r.b2b, true), opts),
    b2cl: toCsv(["Invoice No", "Invoice date", "Invoice value", "Place of supply", "Rate", ...tax], inv(r.b2cl, false), opts),
    b2cs: toCsv(["Type", "Place of supply", "Rate", ...tax], b2csRows, opts),
    cdnr: toCsv(["GSTIN of recipient", "Note No", "Note date", "Note type", "Invoice No", "Invoice date", "Note value", "Place of supply", "Rate", ...tax], notes(r.cdnr, (x) => ("ctin" in x ? x.ctin : "")), opts),
    cdnur: toCsv(["UR type", "Note No", "Note date", "Note type", "Invoice No", "Invoice date", "Note value", "Place of supply", "Rate", ...tax], notes(r.cdnur, () => "B2CL"), opts),
    nil: toCsv(["Description", "Nil rated", "Exempted", "Non-GST"], nilRows, opts),
    hsn: toCsv(["Section", "HSN/SAC", "Taxability", "Rate", "Quantity", "Total value", ...tax], hsnRows, opts),
    docs: toCsv(["Nature of document", "Series", "From", "To", "Total", "Cancelled", "Net issued"], r.docs.map((d) => [d.nature, d.series, d.from, d.to, String(d.total), String(d.cancelled), String(d.net)]), opts),
  };
}

export function gstr3bCsv(r: Gstr3b, opts: { bom?: boolean } = {}): string {
  const t = r.outwardTaxable;
  const rows: string[][] = [
    ["3.1(a)", "Outward taxable supplies", "", rupees(t.taxablePaise), rupees(t.igstPaise), rupees(t.cgstPaise), rupees(t.sgstPaise)],
    ["3.1(c)", "Nil-rated and exempted supplies", "", rupees(r.outwardNilExemptPaise), "", "", ""],
    ["3.1(e)", "Non-GST outward supplies", "", rupees(r.outwardNonGstPaise), "", "", ""],
    ...r.interStateUnregistered.map((x) => ["3.2", "Inter-state supplies to unregistered persons", x.placeOfSupply, rupees(x.taxablePaise), rupees(x.igstPaise), "", ""]),
  ];
  return toCsv(["Table", "Nature of supplies", "Place of supply", "Taxable value", "IGST", "CGST", "SGST"], rows, opts);
}
```

## File: src/gst/breakup.ts

```ts
import { billDiscountShares, type Invoice, type Taxability } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";

/** One invoice line's GST: taxable value after line and bill discounts, and the tax split. */
export interface TaxLine {
  itemIndex: number;
  code?: string;
  name: string;
  category: Invoice["items"][number]["category"];
  hsnSac: string;
  taxability: Taxability;
  qty: number;
  ratePercent: number;
  taxablePaise: number;
  taxPaise: number;
  cgstPaise: number;
  sgstPaise: number;
  igstPaise: number;
}

/** A line's GST treatment: the stored one, else taxable when it carries tax, else exempt. */
export const taxabilityOf = (item: Invoice["items"][number]): Taxability => item.taxability ?? (item.taxPercent > 0 ? "taxable" : "exempt");

/** Splits tax into CGST + SGST (intra-state; CGST takes the lower half of an odd paisa) or IGST. */
export function splitTax(taxPaise: number, interState: boolean): { cgstPaise: number; sgstPaise: number; igstPaise: number } {
  if (interState) return { cgstPaise: 0, sgstPaise: 0, igstPaise: taxPaise };
  const cgst = Math.floor(taxPaise / 2);
  return { cgstPaise: cgst, sgstPaise: taxPaise - cgst, igstPaise: 0 };
}

/**
 * Per-line GST of an invoice, recomputed exactly the way db-kit billed it: the bill discount is shared
 * across lines with the largest-remainder rule, and each line's tax is rounded on its own. The line
 * taxes add up to `invoice.taxPaise`; the split is per line, so returns and postings agree to the paisa.
 */
export function invoiceTaxLines(invoice: Pick<Invoice, "items" | "discountPaise">, interState: boolean): TaxLine[] {
  const items = invoice.items;
  const billDiscount = invoice.discountPaise - items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.discountPaise, 0);
  const shares = billDiscountShares(items.map((i) => i.amountPaise), Math.max(0, billDiscount));
  return items.map((i, idx) => {
    const taxable = i.amountPaise - shares[idx]!;
    const tax = Math.round((taxable * i.taxPercent) / 100);
    return {
      itemIndex: idx, code: i.code, name: i.name, category: i.category, hsnSac: i.hsnSac ?? "", taxability: taxabilityOf(i), qty: i.qty,
      ratePercent: i.taxPercent, taxablePaise: taxable, taxPaise: tax, ...splitTax(tax, interState),
    };
  });
}

export interface RateTotals {
  ratePercent: number;
  taxablePaise: number;
  igstPaise: number;
  cgstPaise: number;
  sgstPaise: number;
  cessPaise: number;
}

/** Taxable lines grouped by GST rate (the shape GSTR-1 uses for invoice items). */
export function byRate(lines: Pick<TaxLine, "ratePercent" | "taxablePaise" | "igstPaise" | "cgstPaise" | "sgstPaise" | "taxability">[]): RateTotals[] {
  const map = new Map<number, RateTotals>();
  for (const l of lines) {
    if (l.taxability !== "taxable") continue;
    const r = map.get(l.ratePercent) ?? { ratePercent: l.ratePercent, taxablePaise: 0, igstPaise: 0, cgstPaise: 0, sgstPaise: 0, cessPaise: 0 };
    r.taxablePaise += l.taxablePaise;
    r.igstPaise += l.igstPaise;
    r.cgstPaise += l.cgstPaise;
    r.sgstPaise += l.sgstPaise;
    map.set(l.ratePercent, r);
  }
  return [...map.values()].sort((a, b) => a.ratePercent - b.ratePercent);
}
```

## File: src/gst/gstr1.ts

```ts
import type { Id, Invoice, Repositories, Taxability } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { financeConfig, VERIFY_WITH_CA } from "../config";
import { istDay } from "../util";
import { byRate, type RateTotals } from "./breakup";
import { addTotals, load, neg, series, zero, type Doc, type ReturnQuery, type Totals } from "./source";
import type { Supply } from "./supply";

export interface Gstr1Invoice {
  invoiceId: Id;
  invoiceNo: string;
  day: string;
  /** Invoice value incl. tax and round-off. */
  valuePaise: number;
  placeOfSupply: string;
  reverseCharge: "N";
  items: RateTotals[];
}

export interface Gstr1Note {
  noteId: Id;
  noteNo: string;
  day: string;
  noteType: "C";
  invoiceNo: string;
  invoiceDay: string;
  valuePaise: number;
  placeOfSupply: string;
  items: RateTotals[];
}

export interface B2csRow {
  supplyType: "INTRA" | "INTER";
  placeOfSupply: string;
  ratePercent: number;
  taxablePaise: number;
  igstPaise: number;
  cgstPaise: number;
  sgstPaise: number;
  cessPaise: number;
}

export interface NilRow {
  description: "Inter-state supplies to registered persons" | "Intra-state supplies to registered persons" | "Inter-state supplies to unregistered persons" | "Intra-state supplies to unregistered persons";
  nilRatedPaise: number;
  exemptedPaise: number;
  nonGstPaise: number;
}

export interface HsnRow {
  hsnSac: string;
  ratePercent: number;
  taxability: Taxability;
  qty: number;
  taxablePaise: number;
  igstPaise: number;
  cgstPaise: number;
  sgstPaise: number;
  cessPaise: number;
  /** taxable + tax */
  totalValuePaise: number;
}

export interface DocSeries {
  nature: "Invoices for outward supply" | "Credit Note";
  series: string;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  total: number;
  cancelled: number;
  net: number;
}


/**
 * GSTR-1 data for a period: B2B (invoice-wise), B2C Large, B2C Small (aggregated, net of their credit
 * notes), credit notes to registered (CDNR) and B2C Large buyers (CDNUR), nil / exempt / non-GST,
 * HSN/SAC summary (B2B and B2C), and the document summary.
 */
export async function gstr1(repos: Repositories, q: ReturnQuery) {
  const cfg = await financeConfig(repos, q.orgId);
  const { gstin, invoices, cancelled, notes, cancelledNotes } = await load(repos, q);
  const isB2cl = (inv: Invoice, supply: Supply) => !inv.buyerGstin && supply.interState && inv.totalPaise > cfg.gst.b2clThresholdPaise;

  const b2b: (Gstr1Invoice & { ctin: string })[] = [];
  const b2cl: Gstr1Invoice[] = [];
  const b2cs = new Map<string, B2csRow>();
  const cdnr: (Gstr1Note & { ctin: string })[] = [];
  const cdnur: (Gstr1Note & { type: "B2CL" })[] = [];
  const nil = new Map<NilRow["description"], NilRow>();
  const hsn = { b2b: new Map<string, HsnRow>(), b2c: new Map<string, HsnRow>() };

  const nilAdd = (d: Doc, l: { taxability?: Taxability; taxablePaise: number }, sign: number) => {
    const t = l.taxability ?? "exempt";
    if (t === "taxable") return;
    const desc = `${d.supply.interState ? "Inter" : "Intra"}-state supplies to ${d.registered ? "registered" : "unregistered"} persons` as NilRow["description"];
    const row = nil.get(desc) ?? { description: desc, nilRatedPaise: 0, exemptedPaise: 0, nonGstPaise: 0 };
    if (t === "nil_rated") row.nilRatedPaise += sign * l.taxablePaise;
    else if (t === "exempt") row.exemptedPaise += sign * l.taxablePaise;
    else row.nonGstPaise += sign * l.taxablePaise;
    nil.set(desc, row);
  };
  const hsnAdd = (d: Doc, l: { hsnSac?: string; taxability?: Taxability; taxPercent?: number; ratePercent?: number; qty?: number; taxablePaise: number; igstPaise: number; cgstPaise: number; sgstPaise: number }, sign: number) => {
    const rate = l.ratePercent ?? l.taxPercent ?? 0;
    const code = l.hsnSac || "UNCLASSIFIED";
    const key = `${code}|${rate}|${l.taxability}`;
    const m = d.registered ? hsn.b2b : hsn.b2c;
    const row = m.get(key) ?? { hsnSac: code, ratePercent: rate, taxability: l.taxability ?? "exempt", qty: 0, taxablePaise: 0, igstPaise: 0, cgstPaise: 0, sgstPaise: 0, cessPaise: 0, totalValuePaise: 0 };
    // a credit note reduces value, not quantity
    if (sign > 0) row.qty += l.qty ?? 0;
    row.taxablePaise += sign * l.taxablePaise;
    row.igstPaise += sign * l.igstPaise;
    row.cgstPaise += sign * l.cgstPaise;
    row.sgstPaise += sign * l.sgstPaise;
    row.totalValuePaise += sign * (l.taxablePaise + l.igstPaise + l.cgstPaise + l.sgstPaise);
    m.set(key, row);
  };
  const b2csAdd = (supply: Supply, items: RateTotals[]) => {
    for (const r of items) {
      const supplyType = supply.interState ? "INTER" : "INTRA";
      const key = `${supplyType}|${supply.placeOfSupply}|${r.ratePercent}`;
      const row = b2cs.get(key) ?? { supplyType, placeOfSupply: supply.placeOfSupply, ratePercent: r.ratePercent, taxablePaise: 0, igstPaise: 0, cgstPaise: 0, sgstPaise: 0, cessPaise: 0 };
      addTotals(row, r);
      b2cs.set(key, row);
    }
  };

  for (const { inv, supply, lines } of invoices) {
    const d: Doc = { supply, registered: Boolean(inv.buyerGstin), lines };
    for (const l of lines) { nilAdd(d, l, 1); hsnAdd(d, l, 1); }
    const items = byRate(lines);
    if (!items.length) continue;
    const base = { invoiceId: inv.id, invoiceNo: inv.invoiceNo, day: istDay(inv.issuedAt ?? inv.createdAt), valuePaise: inv.totalPaise, placeOfSupply: supply.placeOfSupply, reverseCharge: "N" as const, items };
    if (inv.buyerGstin) b2b.push({ ctin: inv.buyerGstin, ...base });
    else if (isB2cl(inv, supply)) b2cl.push(base);
    else b2csAdd(supply, items);
  }
  for (const { note, supply, original } of notes) {
    const d: Doc = { supply, registered: Boolean(note.buyerGstin), lines: note.lines };
    for (const l of note.lines) { nilAdd(d, l, -1); hsnAdd(d, l, -1); }
    const items = byRate(note.lines.map((l) => ({ ...l, ratePercent: l.taxPercent, taxability: l.taxability ?? "exempt" })));
    if (!items.length) continue;
    const base = { noteId: note.id, noteNo: note.noteNo, day: istDay(note.date), noteType: "C" as const, invoiceNo: original.invoiceNo, invoiceDay: istDay(original.issuedAt ?? original.createdAt), valuePaise: note.totalPaise, placeOfSupply: supply.placeOfSupply, items };
    if (note.buyerGstin) cdnr.push({ ctin: note.buyerGstin, ...base });
    else if (isB2cl(original, supply)) cdnur.push({ type: "B2CL", ...base });
    else b2csAdd(supply, items.map(neg));
  }

  const docs: DocSeries[] = [];
  const docSummary = (nature: DocSeries["nature"], live: string[], dead: string[]) => {
    const bySeries = new Map<string, { nos: string[]; cancelled: number }>();
    for (const [no, isDead] of [...live.map((n) => [n, false] as const), ...dead.map((n) => [n, true] as const)]) {
      const s = bySeries.get(series(no)) ?? { nos: [], cancelled: 0 };
      s.nos.push(no);
      if (isDead) s.cancelled++;
      bySeries.set(series(no), s);
    }
    for (const [name, s] of [...bySeries].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))) {
      const sorted = s.nos.sort();
      docs.push({ nature, series: name, from: sorted[0]!, to: sorted.at(-1)!, total: sorted.length, cancelled: s.cancelled, net: sorted.length - s.cancelled });
    }
  };
  docSummary("Invoices for outward supply", invoices.map((x) => x.inv.invoiceNo), cancelled.map((i) => i.invoiceNo));
  docSummary("Credit Note", notes.map((x) => x.note.noteNo), cancelledNotes.map((n) => n.noteNo));

  const totals = zero();
  for (const x of [...b2b, ...b2cl]) for (const r of x.items) addTotals(totals, r);
  for (const r of b2cs.values()) addTotals(totals, r);
  for (const x of [...cdnr, ...cdnur]) for (const r of x.items) addTotals(totals, r, -1);
  // rows a credit note cancelled out entirely carry nothing to report
  const nonZero = (r: { taxablePaise: number; igstPaise: number; cgstPaise: number; sgstPaise: number }) => r.taxablePaise !== 0 || r.igstPaise !== 0 || r.cgstPaise !== 0 || r.sgstPaise !== 0;
  const sortHsn = (m: Map<string, HsnRow>) => [...m.values()].filter(nonZero).sort((a, b) => a.hsnSac.localeCompare(b.hsnSac) || a.ratePercent - b.ratePercent);

  return {
    gstin,
    period: { from: q.from, to: q.to },
    b2b,
    b2cl,
    b2cs: [...b2cs.values()].filter(nonZero).sort((a, b) => a.supplyType.localeCompare(b.supplyType) || a.placeOfSupply.localeCompare(b.placeOfSupply) || a.ratePercent - b.ratePercent),
    cdnr,
    cdnur,
    nil: [...nil.values()].sort((a, b) => a.description.localeCompare(b.description)),
    hsn: { b2b: sortHsn(hsn.b2b), b2c: sortHsn(hsn.b2c) },
    docs,
    /** Net taxable value and tax of taxable outward supplies (invoices less credit notes). */
    totals,
    verifyWithCA: VERIFY_WITH_CA,
  };
}

export type Gstr1 = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof gstr1>>;
```

## File: src/gst/gstr3b.ts

```ts
import type { Repositories, Taxability } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { VERIFY_WITH_CA } from "../config";
import { addTotals, load, zero, type ReturnQuery } from "./source";
import type { Supply } from "./supply";

/**
 * GSTR-3B outward supplies (table 3.1 a, c, e) and inter-state supplies to unregistered persons by
 * place of supply (table 3.2), net of credit notes. Inward supplies and ITC come with payables (Phase 2).
 */
export async function gstr3b(repos: Repositories, q: ReturnQuery) {
  const { gstin, invoices, notes } = await load(repos, q);
  const taxable = zero();
  let nilExempt = 0;
  let nonGst = 0;
  const unreg = new Map<string, { placeOfSupply: string; taxablePaise: number; igstPaise: number }>();
  const add = (supply: Supply, registered: boolean, l: { taxability?: Taxability; taxablePaise: number; igstPaise: number; cgstPaise: number; sgstPaise: number }, sign: number) => {
    const t = l.taxability ?? "exempt";
    if (t === "taxable") {
      addTotals(taxable, l, sign);
      if (supply.interState && !registered) {
        const r = unreg.get(supply.placeOfSupply) ?? { placeOfSupply: supply.placeOfSupply, taxablePaise: 0, igstPaise: 0 };
        r.taxablePaise += sign * l.taxablePaise;
        r.igstPaise += sign * l.igstPaise;
        unreg.set(supply.placeOfSupply, r);
      }
    } else if (t === "non_gst") nonGst += sign * l.taxablePaise;
    else nilExempt += sign * l.taxablePaise;
  };
  for (const { inv, supply, lines } of invoices) for (const l of lines) add(supply, Boolean(inv.buyerGstin), l, 1);
  for (const { note, supply } of notes) for (const l of note.lines) add(supply, Boolean(note.buyerGstin), l, -1);
  return {
    gstin,
    period: { from: q.from, to: q.to },
    /** 3.1(a) outward taxable supplies (other than zero-rated, nil-rated and exempted). */
    outwardTaxable: taxable,
    /** 3.1(c) other outward supplies (nil-rated, exempted). */
    outwardNilExemptPaise: nilExempt,
    /** 3.1(e) non-GST outward supplies. */
    outwardNonGstPaise: nonGst,
    /** 3.2 inter-state supplies to unregistered persons, by place of supply. */
    interStateUnregistered: [...unreg.values()].sort((a, b) => a.placeOfSupply.localeCompare(b.placeOfSupply)),
    verifyWithCA: VERIFY_WITH_CA,
  };
}

export type Gstr3b = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof gstr3b>>;
```

## File: src/gst/place.ts

```ts
import { ValidationError, type Branch, type Customer, type Organization } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";

/** GSTIN format: 2-digit state code, PAN, entity number, "Z", check character. */
const GSTIN_RE = /^\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$/;

export const isValidGstin = (gstin: string): boolean => GSTIN_RE.test(gstin.trim().toUpperCase());

/** The 2-digit state code at the start of a GSTIN. */
export function stateOfGstin(gstin: string | null | undefined): string | undefined {
  const g = gstin?.trim().toUpperCase();
  return g && /^\d{2}/.test(g) ? g.slice(0, 2) : undefined;
}

/** State code a branch supplies from: its stateCode, else its GSTIN, else the organisation's GSTIN. */
export function branchState(branch: Pick<Branch, "stateCode" | "gstin">, org?: Pick<Organization, "gstin"> | null): string {
  const s = branch.stateCode ?? stateOfGstin(branch.gstin) ?? stateOfGstin(org?.gstin);
  if (!s) throw new ValidationError("The branch has no GST state: set branch.stateCode or a GSTIN");
  return s;
}

/** GSTIN a branch's invoices are reported under: its own, else the organisation's. */
export const branchGstin = (branch: Pick<Branch, "gstin">, org?: Pick<Organization, "gstin"> | null): string | undefined =>
  branch.gstin?.toUpperCase() ?? org?.gstin?.toUpperCase();

/**
 * Place of supply (verify with CA): an explicit value wins; a B2B customer with a GSTIN or a state
 * code → the customer's state; otherwise the supplying branch's state.
 */
export function placeOfSupply(input: { branch: Pick<Branch, "stateCode" | "gstin">; org?: Pick<Organization, "gstin"> | null; customer?: Pick<Customer, "stateCode" | "gstin"> | null; override?: string | null }): string {
  if (input.override) return input.override;
  const c = input.customer && (input.customer.stateCode ?? stateOfGstin(input.customer.gstin));
  return c ?? branchState(input.branch, input.org);
}
```

## File: src/gst/rules.ts

```ts
import { ValidationError, type Id, type ItemCategory, type ItemInput, type Repositories, type TaxRule } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { DEFAULT_TAX_RULES, type TaxRuleDef } from "../config";
import { startOfIstDay } from "../util";

/**
 * GST rules are data. A rule says which SAC/HSN, taxability and rate apply to one item code or a whole
 * category from a date. The defaults must be confirmed by the lab's CA (see docs/gst-notes.md).
 */

const VALID_RATES = new Set([0, 0.1, 0.25, 1, 1.5, 3, 5, 6, 7.5, 12, 18, 28, 40]);

export function validateRule(r: Pick<TaxRule, "code" | "category" | "hsnSac" | "taxability" | "ratePercent">): void {
  if (!r.code && !r.category) throw new ValidationError("A tax rule needs an item code or a category");
  if (!/^\d{4,8}$/.test(r.hsnSac)) throw new ValidationError(`SAC/HSN must be 4–8 digits: "${r.hsnSac}"`);
  if (!VALID_RATES.has(r.ratePercent)) throw new ValidationError(`Unknown GST rate ${r.ratePercent}%`);
  if (r.taxability === "taxable" ? r.ratePercent <= 0 : r.ratePercent !== 0) throw new ValidationError("Only taxable rules carry a rate above 0");
}

/** Adds a rule (validated). Rules are effective-dated: add a new one rather than editing an old one. */
export async function addTaxRule(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id, def: TaxRuleDef, actorId?: Id): Promise<TaxRule> {
  const rule = { code: def.code ?? null, category: def.category ?? null, hsnSac: def.hsnSac, taxability: def.taxability, ratePercent: def.ratePercent };
  validateRule(rule);
  const created = await repos.taxRules.create({ orgId, ...rule, effectiveFrom: startOfIstDay(def.effectiveFrom), effectiveTo: null, note: def.note });
  await repos.audit.log({ orgId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.tax_rule.add", entity: "tax_rule", entityId: created.id, data: { ...rule } });
  return created;
}

/** Seeds DEFAULT_TAX_RULES (or the given ones) when the organisation has no rules yet. */
export async function seedTaxRules(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id, defs: TaxRuleDef[] = DEFAULT_TAX_RULES, actorId?: Id): Promise<TaxRule[]> {
  if ((await repos.taxRules.count({ orgId })) > 0) return repos.taxRules.find({ orgId });
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const out: TaxRule[] = [];
    for (const d of defs) out.push(await addTaxRule(tx, orgId, d, actorId));
    return out;
  });
}

const activeOn = (r: TaxRule, at: Date) => r.effectiveFrom.getTime() <= at.getTime() && (!r.effectiveTo || at.getTime() <= r.effectiveTo.getTime());

/**
 * The rule for an item on a date: a rule for its code beats a rule for its category; among those, the
 * latest effectiveFrom wins. undefined when nothing applies.
 */
export function resolveTaxRule(rules: TaxRule[], item: { code?: string; category?: ItemCategory }, at: Date): TaxRule | undefined {
  const pick = (xs: TaxRule[]) => xs.filter((r) => activeOn(r, at)).sort((a, b) => b.effectiveFrom.getTime() - a.effectiveFrom.getTime())[0];
  return (item.code ? pick(rules.filter((r) => r.code === item.code)) : undefined) ?? pick(rules.filter((r) => !r.code && r.category === (item.category ?? "test")));
}

/**
 * Fills taxPercent, hsnSac and taxability on invoice items from the organisation's rules, for db-kit's
 * issueInvoice. Throws ValidationError for an item no rule covers: the CA must classify it first.
 */
export async function applyTaxRules(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id, items: ItemInput[], at: Date = new Date()): Promise<ItemInput[]> {
  const rules = await repos.taxRules.find({ orgId });
  return items.map((i) => {
    const rule = resolveTaxRule(rules, i, at);
    if (!rule) throw new ValidationError(`No GST rule for ${i.code ? `item ${i.code}` : `"${i.name}"`} (${i.category ?? "test"}); add one (verify with CA)`);
    return { ...i, taxPercent: rule.ratePercent, hsnSac: rule.hsnSac, taxability: rule.taxability };
  });
}
```

## File: src/gst/source.ts

```ts
import { ValidationError, type CreditNote, type Id, type Invoice, type Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { invoiceTaxLines, type RateTotals, type TaxLine } from "./breakup";
import { supplyResolver, type Supply } from "./supply";

/**
 * GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B data built from invoices and credit notes, as plain JSON in paise.
 * Our own shapes: the official GST portal JSON can be generated from them later (Phase 2).
 */

export interface ReturnQuery {
  orgId: Id;
  /** The GSTIN filed for (branches reporting under it). Default: the organisation's GSTIN. */
  gstin?: string;
  from: Date;
  to: Date;
}

export interface Totals {
  taxablePaise: number;
  igstPaise: number;
  cgstPaise: number;
  sgstPaise: number;
  cessPaise: number;
}

export interface Doc {
  supply: Supply;
  registered: boolean;
  lines: TaxLine[] | CreditNote["lines"];
}

export function scope(repos: Repositories, q: ReturnQuery) {
  const resolve = supplyResolver(repos);
  let gstin = q.gstin?.toUpperCase();
  return {
    resolve,
    async gstinOf(): Promise<string> {
      if (!gstin) gstin = (await repos.orgs.get(q.orgId))?.gstin?.toUpperCase();
      if (!gstin) throw new ValidationError("No GSTIN: pass one or set the organisation's");
      return gstin;
    },
  };
}

export async function load(repos: Repositories, q: ReturnQuery) {
  const s = scope(repos, q);
  const gstin = await s.gstinOf();
  const all = await repos.invoices.listByDate({ orgId: q.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, includeCancelled: true });
  const invoices: { inv: Invoice; supply: Supply; lines: TaxLine[] }[] = [];
  const cancelled: Invoice[] = [];
  for (const inv of all) {
    const supply = await s.resolve(inv);
    if (supply.gstin !== gstin) continue;
    if (inv.status === "cancelled") cancelled.push(inv);
    else invoices.push({ inv, supply, lines: invoiceTaxLines(inv, supply.interState) });
  }
  const notesAll = await repos.creditNotes.listByDate({ orgId: q.orgId, from: q.from, to: q.to, includeCancelled: true });
  const originals = new Map((await repos.invoices.getMany([...new Set(notesAll.map((n) => n.invoiceId))])).map((i) => [i.id, i]));
  const notes: { note: CreditNote; supply: Supply; original: Invoice }[] = [];
  const cancelledNotes: CreditNote[] = [];
  for (const note of notesAll) {
    const original = originals.get(note.invoiceId)!;
    const supply = await s.resolve({ ...original, placeOfSupply: note.placeOfSupply ?? original.placeOfSupply });
    if (supply.gstin !== gstin) continue;
    if (note.status === "cancelled") cancelledNotes.push(note);
    else notes.push({ note, supply, original });
  }
  return { gstin, invoices, cancelled, notes, cancelledNotes };
}

export const neg = (r: RateTotals): RateTotals => ({ ...r, taxablePaise: -r.taxablePaise, igstPaise: -r.igstPaise, cgstPaise: -r.cgstPaise, sgstPaise: -r.sgstPaise, cessPaise: -r.cessPaise });
export const addTotals = (t: Totals, r: { taxablePaise: number; igstPaise: number; cgstPaise: number; sgstPaise: number; cessPaise?: number }, sign = 1) => {
  t.taxablePaise += sign * r.taxablePaise;
  t.igstPaise += sign * r.igstPaise;
  t.cgstPaise += sign * r.cgstPaise;
  t.sgstPaise += sign * r.sgstPaise;
  t.cessPaise += sign * (r.cessPaise ?? 0);
};
export const zero = (): Totals => ({ taxablePaise: 0, igstPaise: 0, cgstPaise: 0, sgstPaise: 0, cessPaise: 0 });
export const series = (no: string) => no.slice(0, no.lastIndexOf("/") + 1);
```

## File: src/gst/supply.ts

```ts
import { NotFoundError, type Branch, type Invoice, type Organization, type Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { branchGstin, branchState } from "./place";

export interface Supply {
  branch: Branch;
  /** GSTIN the invoice is reported under. */
  gstin?: string;
  branchState: string;
  placeOfSupply: string;
  interState: boolean;
}

/** Looks up branches and the organisation once per report. */
export function supplyResolver(repos: Repositories) {
  const branches = new Map<string, Promise<Branch | null>>();
  const orgs = new Map<string, Promise<Organization | null>>();
  return async (invoice: Pick<Invoice, "orgId" | "branchId" | "placeOfSupply">): Promise<Supply> => {
    if (!branches.has(invoice.branchId)) branches.set(invoice.branchId, repos.branches.get(invoice.branchId));
    if (!orgs.has(invoice.orgId)) orgs.set(invoice.orgId, repos.orgs.get(invoice.orgId));
    const branch = await branches.get(invoice.branchId)!;
    if (!branch) throw new NotFoundError("Branch", invoice.branchId);
    const org = await orgs.get(invoice.orgId)!;
    const from = branchState(branch, org);
    const pos = invoice.placeOfSupply ?? from;
    return { branch, gstin: branchGstin(branch, org), branchState: from, placeOfSupply: pos, interState: pos !== from };
  };
}
```

## File: src/partners/partners.ts

```ts
import {
  ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError, type Address, type AgreementKind, type Id, type ItemCategory, type Partner, type PartnerAgreement,
  type PartnerKind, type Repositories,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { isValidGstin, stateOfGstin } from "../gst/place";
import { createPartyLedger } from "../posting";
import { endOfIstDay, startOfIstDay } from "../util";

/**
 * Collection centres and franchises: business partners paid a share of what their tests bill.
 * Not for doctors: referral payments to doctors are not built, on purpose (medical ethics rules).
 */

export interface PartnerInput {
  orgId: Id;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  kind: PartnerKind;
  /** The branch whose invoices earn this partner a share. */
  branchId: Id;
  legalName?: string;
  pan?: string;
  gstin?: string;
  stateCode?: string;
  phone?: string;
  email?: string;
  address?: Address;
  /** Overrides the default TDS section / rate (e.g. a lower-deduction certificate). Verify with CA. */
  tds?: { section: string; rateBp: number } | null;
}

const PAN_RE = /^[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z]$/;

function checkPartner(p: Partial<PartnerInput>) {
  if (p.pan !== undefined && p.pan !== "" && !PAN_RE.test(p.pan.toUpperCase())) throw new ValidationError(`Invalid PAN "${p.pan}"`);
  if (p.gstin !== undefined && p.gstin !== "" && !isValidGstin(p.gstin)) throw new ValidationError(`Invalid GSTIN "${p.gstin}"`);
  if (p.tds && !(Number.isInteger(p.tds.rateBp) && p.tds.rateBp >= 0 && p.tds.rateBp <= 10000 && p.tds.section.trim())) throw new ValidationError("TDS override needs a section and a rate of 0–10000 bp");
}

/** Creates a partner with its own payable ledger under Sundry Creditors. */
export async function createPartner(repos: Repositories, input: PartnerInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<Partner> {
  checkPartner(input);
  const code = input.code.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!/^[A-Z0-9_-]{2,32}$/.test(code)) throw new ValidationError(`Partner code must be 2–32 letters, digits, - or _: "${input.code}"`);
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const branch = await tx.branches.get(input.branchId);
    if (!branch || branch.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Branch", input.branchId);
    if (await tx.partners.findOne({ orgId: input.orgId, code })) throw new ConflictError(`Partner ${code} already exists`);
    const ledger = await createPartyLedger(tx, input.orgId, `${input.name} [${code}] share payable`, "Sundry Creditors");
    const gstin = input.gstin ? input.gstin.toUpperCase() : undefined;
    const partner = await tx.partners.create({
      ...input, code, pan: input.pan?.toUpperCase(), gstin, stateCode: input.stateCode ?? stateOfGstin(gstin), ledgerId: ledger.id, tds: input.tds ?? null, active: true,
    });
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: input.orgId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.partner.create", entity: "partner", entityId: partner.id, data: { code } });
    return partner;
  });
}

export type PartnerUpdate = { orgId: Id; partnerId: Id } & Partial<Omit<PartnerInput, "orgId" | "code" | "branchId">> & { active?: boolean };

/** Changes details or TDS settings. The code, branch and ledger stay. */
export async function updatePartner(repos: Repositories, input: PartnerUpdate, actorId?: Id): Promise<Partner> {
  const { orgId, partnerId, ...patch } = input;
  checkPartner(patch);
  const p = await repos.partners.get(partnerId);
  if (!p || p.orgId !== orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Partner", partnerId);
  const out = (await repos.partners.update(partnerId, { ...patch, ...(patch.pan ? { pan: patch.pan.toUpperCase() } : {}) }))!;
  await repos.audit.log({ orgId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.partner.update", entity: "partner", entityId: partnerId, data: { fields: Object.keys(patch) } });
  return out;
}

export interface AgreementInput {
  orgId: Id;
  partnerId: Id;
  kind: AgreementKind;
  /** revenue_share: basis points of the net billed value (2500 = 25%). */
  shareBp?: number;
  /** fixed_rate: amount per unit by item code. */
  rates?: { code: string; sharePaise: number }[];
  defaultSharePaise?: number;
  /** Default: test, package. */
  categories?: ItemCategory[];
  /** IST day the agreement starts. */
  effectiveFrom: string;
  /** IST day it ends (inclusive); omit for open-ended. */
  effectiveTo?: string;
  notes?: string;
}

/**
 * Adds an effective-dated agreement. A partner's agreements may not overlap: to change terms, end
 * the current one (`endAgreement`) the day before the new one starts, or add the new one and the open
 * one is ended automatically.
 */
export async function addAgreement(repos: Repositories, input: AgreementInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<PartnerAgreement> {
  if (input.kind === "revenue_share") {
    if (!(Number.isInteger(input.shareBp) && input.shareBp! >= 0 && input.shareBp! <= 10000)) throw new ValidationError("revenue_share needs shareBp of 0–10000");
  } else {
    if (!input.rates?.length && input.defaultSharePaise == null) throw new ValidationError("fixed_rate needs rates or defaultSharePaise");
    for (const r of input.rates ?? []) if (!(Number.isSafeInteger(r.sharePaise) && r.sharePaise >= 0)) throw new ValidationError(`Rate for ${r.code} must be whole paise ≥ 0`);
    if (new Set((input.rates ?? []).map((r) => r.code)).size !== (input.rates ?? []).length) throw new ValidationError("Duplicate item code in rates");
  }
  const from = startOfIstDay(input.effectiveFrom);
  const to = input.effectiveTo ? endOfIstDay(input.effectiveTo) : null;
  if (to && to.getTime() < from.getTime()) throw new ValidationError("effectiveTo is before effectiveFrom");
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const partner = await tx.partners.get(input.partnerId);
    if (!partner || partner.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Partner", input.partnerId);
    for (const a of await tx.partnerAgreements.find({ partnerId: partner.id })) {
      const aEnd = a.effectiveTo?.getTime() ?? Infinity;
      if (!a.effectiveTo && a.effectiveFrom.getTime() < from.getTime()) {
        // the open agreement ends the moment before the new one starts
        await tx.partnerAgreements.update(a.id, { effectiveTo: new Date(from.getTime() - 1) });
        continue;
      }
      if (a.effectiveFrom.getTime() <= (to?.getTime() ?? Infinity) && from.getTime() <= aEnd) throw new ConflictError("Agreements of a partner may not overlap");
    }
    const ag = await tx.partnerAgreements.create({
      orgId: input.orgId, partnerId: partner.id, kind: input.kind, shareBp: input.kind === "revenue_share" ? input.shareBp! : null,
      rates: input.kind === "fixed_rate" ? input.rates ?? [] : [], defaultSharePaise: input.kind === "fixed_rate" ? input.defaultSharePaise ?? null : null,
      categories: input.categories, effectiveFrom: from, effectiveTo: to, notes: input.notes,
    });
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: input.orgId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.agreement.add", entity: "partner_agreement", entityId: ag.id, data: { partnerId: partner.id, kind: input.kind } });
    return ag;
  });
}

/** The agreement in force at an instant (latest start wins). */
export function agreementOn(agreements: PartnerAgreement[], at: Date): PartnerAgreement | undefined {
  return agreements
    .filter((a) => a.effectiveFrom.getTime() <= at.getTime() && (!a.effectiveTo || at.getTime() <= a.effectiveTo.getTime()))
    .sort((a, b) => b.effectiveFrom.getTime() - a.effectiveFrom.getTime())[0];
}
```
