## File: src/partners/settlements.ts

```ts
import {
  ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError, type Id, type Invoice, type ItemCategory, type Partner, type PartnerAgreement, type PaymentMode,
  type Repositories, type Settlement, type SettlementDeduction, type SettlementLine,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { financeConfig, type FinanceConfig } from "../config";
import { invoiceTaxLines } from "../gst/breakup";
import { cancel, ledgerId, ledgerIds, line, MODE_LEDGER, post } from "../posting";
import { applyBp, divRound, fyOf, istDay, monthRange } from "../util";
import { agreementOn } from "./partners";

const DEFAULT_CATEGORIES: ItemCategory[] = ["test", "package"];

export interface TdsResult {
  section: string | null;
  rateBp: number;
  basePaise: number;
  tdsPaise: number;
}

/**
 * TDS on a partner's share (all values configuration; verify with CA):
 * - rate: the partner's override, else the default rate (with a PAN) or the no-PAN rate;
 * - nothing is deducted until the partner's shares in the financial year exceed the threshold; the
 *   settlement that crosses it deducts on the whole year so far (earlier shares not yet taxed included);
 * - TDS is rounded to the nearest rupee.
 */
export function computeTds(input: { sharePaise: number; priorSharePaise: number; priorBasePaise: number; partner: Pick<Partner, "pan" | "tds">; config: FinanceConfig["tds"] }): TdsResult {
  const { partner, config } = input;
  const section = partner.tds?.section ?? config.section;
  const rateBp = partner.tds?.rateBp ?? (partner.pan ? config.rateBp : config.noPanRateBp);
  const crossed = config.thresholdPaise === null || input.priorSharePaise + input.sharePaise > config.thresholdPaise;
  const basePaise = crossed ? Math.max(0, input.sharePaise + input.priorSharePaise - input.priorBasePaise) : 0;
  return { section, rateBp, basePaise, tdsPaise: divRound(basePaise * rateBp, 1_000_000) * 100 };
}

/** A fixed-rate agreement's amount for one invoice line. */
function fixedShare(ag: PartnerAgreement, code: string | undefined, qty: number): number {
  const per = (code ? ag.rates?.find((r) => r.code === code)?.sharePaise : undefined) ?? ag.defaultSharePaise ?? 0;
  return Math.round(per * qty);
}

export interface SettlementCalc {
  partner: Partner;
  period: string;
  from: Date;
  to: Date;
  lines: SettlementLine[];
  grossPaise: number;
  sharePaise: number;
  deductions: SettlementDeduction[];
  deductionsPaise: number;
  tds: TdsResult;
  netPaise: number;
  /** Invoices of the month with no agreement in force on their date. */
  uncoveredInvoices: string[];
}

/**
 * A partner's month, computed from the invoices of its branch: each eligible line earns the share of
 * the agreement in force on the invoice date (revenue share: bp of the line's net billed value, after
 * line and bill discounts and before GST, rounded per line; fixed rate: amount × quantity). Credit
 * notes dated in the month take back the share in proportion to the value credited.
 */
export async function computeSettlement(repos: Repositories, input: { orgId: Id; partnerId: Id; period: string; deductions?: SettlementDeduction[] }): Promise<SettlementCalc> {
  const partner = await repos.partners.get(input.partnerId);
  if (!partner || partner.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Partner", input.partnerId);
  const { from, to } = monthRange(input.period);
  const cfg = await financeConfig(repos, input.orgId);
  const agreements = await repos.partnerAgreements.find({ partnerId: partner.id });
  const lines: SettlementLine[] = [];
  const uncovered: string[] = [];
  const eligible = (ag: PartnerAgreement, c: ItemCategory) => (ag.categories ?? DEFAULT_CATEGORIES).includes(c);

  const invoices = await repos.invoices.listByDate({ orgId: input.orgId, branchId: partner.branchId, from, to });
  for (const inv of invoices) {
    const at = inv.issuedAt ?? inv.createdAt;
    const ag = agreementOn(agreements, at);
    if (!ag) { uncovered.push(inv.invoiceNo); continue; }
    for (const t of invoiceTaxLines(inv, false)) {
      if (!eligible(ag, t.category)) continue;
      const share = ag.kind === "revenue_share" ? applyBp(t.taxablePaise, ag.shareBp ?? 0) : fixedShare(ag, t.code, t.qty);
      lines.push({ invoiceId: inv.id, invoiceNo: inv.invoiceNo, day: istDay(at), code: t.code, name: t.name, netPaise: t.taxablePaise, sharePaise: share, agreementId: ag.id, creditNoteId: null });
    }
  }

  const notes = await repos.creditNotes.listByDate({ orgId: input.orgId, branchId: partner.branchId, from, to });
  const originals = new Map<Id, Invoice>((await repos.invoices.getMany([...new Set(notes.map((n) => n.invoiceId))])).map((i) => [i.id, i]));
  for (const note of notes) {
    const inv = originals.get(note.invoiceId)!;
    const ag = agreementOn(agreements, inv.issuedAt ?? inv.createdAt);
    if (!ag) continue;
    const tax = invoiceTaxLines(inv, false);
    for (const l of note.lines) {
      const t = tax[l.itemIndex]!;
      if (!eligible(ag, t.category)) continue;
      const full = ag.kind === "revenue_share" ? null : fixedShare(ag, t.code, t.qty);
      const share = full === null ? -applyBp(l.taxablePaise, ag.shareBp ?? 0) : t.taxablePaise > 0 ? -divRound(full * l.taxablePaise, t.taxablePaise) : 0;
      lines.push({ invoiceId: inv.id, invoiceNo: inv.invoiceNo, day: istDay(note.date), code: t.code, name: `${t.name} (credit note ${note.noteNo})`, netPaise: -l.taxablePaise, sharePaise: share, agreementId: ag.id, creditNoteId: note.id });
    }
  }

  const deductions = (input.deductions ?? []).map((d) => {
    if (!d.label?.trim() || !(Number.isSafeInteger(d.amountPaise) && d.amountPaise > 0)) throw new ValidationError("Each deduction needs a label and a positive amount in paise");
    return { label: d.label.trim(), amountPaise: d.amountPaise, ledgerId: d.ledgerId ?? null };
  });
  for (const d of deductions) {
    if (!d.ledgerId) continue;
    const l = await repos.ledgers.get(d.ledgerId);
    if (!l || l.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger", d.ledgerId);
  }
  const sharePaise = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.sharePaise, 0);
  const fy = fyOf(istDay(from));
  const prior = (await repos.settlements.find({ partnerId: partner.id }))
    .filter((s) => (s.status === "accrued" || s.status === "paid") && fyOf(`${s.period}-01`) === fy && s.period < input.period);
  const tds = computeTds({
    sharePaise, priorSharePaise: prior.reduce((s, x) => s + x.sharePaise, 0), priorBasePaise: prior.reduce((s, x) => s + x.tdsBasePaise, 0), partner, config: cfg.tds,
  });
  const deductionsPaise = deductions.reduce((s, d) => s + d.amountPaise, 0);
  return {
    partner, period: input.period, from, to, lines, grossPaise: lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.netPaise, 0), sharePaise, deductions, deductionsPaise, tds,
    netPaise: sharePaise - deductionsPaise - tds.tdsPaise, uncoveredInvoices: uncovered,
  };
}

const fields = (c: SettlementCalc) => ({
  lines: c.lines, grossPaise: c.grossPaise, sharePaise: c.sharePaise, deductions: c.deductions, deductionsPaise: c.deductionsPaise,
  tdsSection: c.tds.section, tdsRateBp: c.tds.rateBp, tdsBasePaise: c.tds.basePaise, tdsPaise: c.tds.tdsPaise, netPaise: c.netPaise,
});

/** Stores a draft settlement for a partner's month (one live settlement per partner per month). */
export async function createSettlement(repos: Repositories, input: { orgId: Id; partnerId: Id; period: string; deductions?: SettlementDeduction[] }, actorId?: Id): Promise<Settlement> {
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const calc = await computeSettlement(tx, input);
    if (await tx.settlements.findOne({ orgId: input.orgId, periodKey: `${calc.partner.id}:${input.period}` })) throw new ConflictError(`A settlement for ${calc.partner.code} ${input.period} already exists`);
    const s = await tx.settlements.create({
      orgId: input.orgId, branchId: calc.partner.branchId, partnerId: calc.partner.id, period: input.period, periodKey: `${calc.partner.id}:${input.period}`,
      from: calc.from, to: calc.to, ...fields(calc), status: "draft", accrualVoucherId: null, payoutVoucherId: null, paidAt: null, createdBy: actorId ?? null,
    });
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: input.orgId, branchId: s.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.settlement.create", entity: "settlement", entityId: s.id, data: { period: input.period } });
    return s;
  });
}

/**
 * Recomputes a draft settlement and books it, dated the month's last day:
 *   Dr Collection Centre Share   share        Cr Partner payable   share
 *   Dr Partner payable           TDS          Cr TDS Payable       TDS
 *   Dr Partner payable           deductions   Cr Recoveries (or the deduction's ledger)
 */
export async function accrueSettlement(repos: Repositories, input: { orgId: Id; settlementId: Id; now?: Date }, actorId?: Id): Promise<Settlement> {
  const now = input.now ?? new Date();
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const s = await tx.settlements.getForUpdate(input.settlementId);
    if (!s || s.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Settlement", input.settlementId);
    if (s.status !== "draft") throw new ConflictError(`Settlement is ${s.status}`);
    if (now.getTime() <= s.to.getTime()) throw new ConflictError(`${s.period} has not ended yet`);
    const calc = await computeSettlement(tx, { orgId: s.orgId, partnerId: s.partnerId, period: s.period, deductions: s.deductions });
    const k = await ledgerIds(tx, s.orgId, ["partner_share", "tds_payable", "partner_recoveries"] as const);
    const payable = calc.partner.ledgerId;
    const entries = [
      line(k.partner_share, calc.sharePaise), line(payable, -calc.sharePaise),
      line(payable, calc.tds.tdsPaise), line(k.tds_payable, -calc.tds.tdsPaise),
      ...calc.deductions.flatMap((d) => [line(payable, d.amountPaise), line(d.ledgerId ?? k.partner_recoveries, -d.amountPaise)]),
    ].filter((e) => e.debitPaise > 0 || e.creditPaise > 0);
    const voucher = entries.length
      ? await post(tx, { orgId: s.orgId, branchId: s.branchId, type: "journal", date: s.to, narration: `Settlement ${calc.partner.code} ${s.period}`, entries }, actorId)
      : null;
    const out = (await tx.settlements.update(s.id, { ...fields(calc), status: "accrued", accrualVoucherId: voucher?.id ?? null }))!;
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: s.orgId, branchId: s.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.settlement.accrue", entity: "settlement", entityId: s.id, data: { sharePaise: calc.sharePaise, tdsPaise: calc.tds.tdsPaise, netPaise: calc.netPaise } });
    return out;
  });
}

/** Pays the net amount: Payment voucher Dr Partner payable, Cr Bank / Cash. */
export async function paySettlement(repos: Repositories, input: { orgId: Id; settlementId: Id; mode: PaymentMode; date?: Date; reference?: string }, actorId?: Id): Promise<Settlement> {
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const s = await tx.settlements.getForUpdate(input.settlementId);
    if (!s || s.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Settlement", input.settlementId);
    if (s.status !== "accrued") throw new ConflictError(`Only an accrued settlement can be paid (this one is ${s.status})`);
    if (s.netPaise <= 0) throw new ConflictError("Nothing to pay: the net amount is not positive");
    const partner = (await tx.partners.get(s.partnerId))!;
    const date = input.date ?? new Date();
    const voucher = await post(tx, {
      orgId: s.orgId, branchId: s.branchId, type: "payment", date,
      narration: `Settlement payout ${partner.code} ${s.period}${input.reference ? ` ref ${input.reference}` : ""}`,
      entries: [line(partner.ledgerId, s.netPaise), line(await ledgerId(tx, s.orgId, MODE_LEDGER[input.mode]), -s.netPaise)],
    }, actorId);
    const out = (await tx.settlements.update(s.id, { status: "paid", payoutVoucherId: voucher.id, paidAt: date }))!;
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: s.orgId, branchId: s.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.settlement.pay", entity: "settlement", entityId: s.id, data: { netPaise: s.netPaise, mode: input.mode } });
    return out;
  });
}

/** Cancels a draft or accrued settlement (the accrual voucher is cancelled) and frees its month. */
export async function cancelSettlement(repos: Repositories, input: { orgId: Id; settlementId: Id }, actorId?: Id): Promise<Settlement> {
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const s = await tx.settlements.getForUpdate(input.settlementId);
    if (!s || s.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Settlement", input.settlementId);
    if (s.status === "cancelled") return s;
    if (s.status === "paid") throw new ConflictError("A paid settlement cannot be cancelled; book a correction in the next month");
    if (s.accrualVoucherId) await cancel(tx, s.accrualVoucherId, actorId);
    const out = (await tx.settlements.update(s.id, { status: "cancelled", periodKey: null }))!;
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: s.orgId, branchId: s.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.settlement.cancel", entity: "settlement", entityId: s.id });
    return out;
  });
}
```

## File: src/periods/locks.ts

```ts
import { NotFoundError, type Id, type PeriodLock, type Repositories } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { endOfIstDay, istDay } from "../util";

/**
 * Lock dates. No voucher dated on or before an organisation's or a branch's lock date may be posted
 * or cancelled. The accounting engine enforces it inside every posting transaction (db-kit
 * assertPeriodOpen); this module sets and reads the dates.
 */

export interface LockInput {
  orgId: Id;
  /** Omit or null for the whole organisation. */
  branchId?: Id | null;
  /** Last locked IST day, "2026-09-30"; null removes the lock. */
  upTo: string | null;
  reason?: string;
}

/**
 * Sets a lock date. Takes the lock row exclusively, so postings in flight finish first and new ones
 * see the new date. Moving a lock backwards (re-opening days) is allowed and audited.
 */
export async function setLockDate(repos: Repositories, input: LockInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<PeriodLock> {
  const lockedUpTo = input.upTo === null ? null : endOfIstDay(input.upTo);
  const scope = input.branchId ?? "org";
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    if (input.branchId) {
      const b = await tx.branches.get(input.branchId);
      if (!b || b.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Branch", input.branchId);
    }
    const [lock] = await tx.periodLocks.hold(input.orgId, [scope], "update");
    const before = lock!.lockedUpTo;
    const out = (await tx.periodLocks.update(lock!.id, { lockedUpTo, reason: input.reason, updatedBy: actorId ?? null }))!;
    await tx.audit.log({
      orgId: input.orgId, branchId: input.branchId ?? null, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.period.lock", entity: "period_lock", entityId: out.id,
      data: { scope, from: before ? istDay(before) : null, to: input.upTo, reason: input.reason ?? null },
    });
    return out;
  });
}

/** The lock that applies to a branch: the later of the organisation's and the branch's dates. */
export async function lockDateFor(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id, branchId?: Id): Promise<Date | null> {
  const locks = await repos.periodLocks.find({ orgId });
  const dates = locks.filter((l) => l.scope === "org" || l.scope === branchId).map((l) => l.lockedUpTo).filter((d): d is Date => d !== null);
  return dates.length ? new Date(Math.max(...dates.map((d) => d.getTime()))) : null;
}

/** Every lock row of the organisation (scope "org" and branches). */
export const listLocks = (repos: Repositories, orgId: Id) => repos.periodLocks.find({ orgId }, { sort: { field: "scope" } });
```

## File: src/periods/year-end.ts

```ts
import { ConflictError, ValidationError, type Id, type Repositories, type Voucher } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { ledgerId, line, post, profitAndLoss } from "../posting";
import { fyRange } from "../util";

/**
 * Closes a financial year, in one transaction:
 * 1. takes the organisation's lock row exclusively (no posting can land meanwhile);
 * 2. for each branch, a Closing voucher dated 31 March 23:59:59.999 IST reverses that branch's income
 *    and expense balances for the year and moves the result to "Profit & Loss A/c" (Reserves & Surplus);
 * 3. locks the organisation up to the year end.
 * Balance-sheet ledgers carry forward as they are (balances are running sums), so the next year opens
 * with the closing balances, P&L ledgers start at zero, and profitAndLoss for the closed year still
 * shows its result (closing vouchers are left out of it).
 */
export async function closeFinancialYear(repos: Repositories, input: { orgId: Id; fy: string; now?: Date }, actorId?: Id): Promise<{ vouchers: Voucher[]; netProfitPaise: number }> {
  const now = input.now ?? new Date();
  const { from, to, last } = fyRange(input.fy);
  if (now.getTime() <= to.getTime()) throw new ConflictError(`Financial year ${input.fy} has not ended`);
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [lock] = await tx.periodLocks.hold(input.orgId, ["org"], "update");
    if (lock!.lockedUpTo && lock!.lockedUpTo.getTime() >= to.getTime()) throw new ConflictError(`The books are locked up to ${lock!.lockedUpTo.toISOString()}: ${input.fy} is closed or locked`);
    if ((await tx.vouchers.listByDate({ orgId: input.orgId, type: "closing", from, to })).length) throw new ConflictError(`${input.fy} already has a closing voucher`);
    for (const l of await tx.ledgers.find({ orgId: input.orgId })) {
      const g = await tx.accountGroups.get(l.groupId);
      let p = g;
      while (p?.parentId) p = await tx.accountGroups.get(p.parentId);
      if ((p?.nature === "income" || p?.nature === "expenses") && l.openingPaise !== 0) throw new ValidationError(`Income / expense ledger "${l.name}" has an opening balance; move it to a voucher first`);
    }
    const retained = await ledgerId(tx, input.orgId, "retained_earnings");
    const vouchers: Voucher[] = [];
    let total = 0;
    for (const branch of await tx.branches.find({ orgId: input.orgId }, { sort: { field: "code" } })) {
      const pl = await profitAndLoss(tx, { orgId: input.orgId, branchId: branch.id, from, to });
      const entries = [
        ...pl.income.flatMap((g) => g.ledgers.map((x) => line(x.ledger.id, x.amountPaise))),
        ...pl.expenses.flatMap((g) => g.ledgers.map((x) => line(x.ledger.id, -x.amountPaise))),
        line(retained, -pl.netProfitPaise),
      ].filter((e) => e.debitPaise > 0 || e.creditPaise > 0);
      if (entries.length < 2) continue;
      // A branch whose cash day 31 March is closed is locked through the closing instant. Inside this
      // transaction (its lock row held exclusively) the lock steps back by 1 ms for the closing voucher
      // and is restored before commit, so nobody else ever sees it open.
      const [bl] = await tx.periodLocks.hold(input.orgId, [branch.id], "update");
      const held = bl!.lockedUpTo && bl!.lockedUpTo.getTime() >= to.getTime() ? bl!.lockedUpTo : null;
      if (held) await tx.periodLocks.update(bl!.id, { lockedUpTo: new Date(to.getTime() - 1) });
      vouchers.push(await post(tx, { orgId: input.orgId, branchId: branch.id, type: "closing", date: to, narration: `Year-end closing ${input.fy} (${branch.code})`, entries }, actorId));
      if (held) await tx.periodLocks.update(bl!.id, { lockedUpTo: held });
      total += pl.netProfitPaise;
    }
    await tx.periodLocks.update(lock!.id, { lockedUpTo: to, reason: `year end ${input.fy} (${last})`, updatedBy: actorId ?? null });
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: input.orgId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.year.close", entity: "period_lock", entityId: lock!.id, data: { fy: input.fy, netProfitPaise: total, vouchers: vouchers.map((v) => v.voucherNo) } });
    return { vouchers, netProfitPaise: total };
  });
}
```

## File: src/posting.ts

```ts
/**
 * THE ONLY MODULE THAT TALKS TO THE ACCOUNTING ENGINE.
 *
 * The engine is ledger-kit, our own accounting kit (postVoucher, cancelVoucher, chart of accounts,
 * books reports). Storage, types and errors come from db-kit. `scripts/test.ts` fails if another
 * file imports the engine functions from db-kit or ledger-kit. No Tally software integration of any kind.
 */
import {
  NotFoundError, ValidationError, type Id, type Invoice, type Ledger, type Payment, type PaymentMode, type PostingHook, type Repositories,
  type Voucher, type VoucherEntry, type VoucherType,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import {
  balanceSheet, cancelVoucher, dayBook, ledgerBalance, ledgerStatement, postVoucher, profitAndLoss, seedChartOfAccounts, trialBalance,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/ledger-kit";
import { invoiceTaxLines } from "./gst/breakup";
import { supplyResolver } from "./gst/supply";

export { balanceSheet, dayBook, ledgerBalance, ledgerStatement, profitAndLoss, trialBalance };
export type { Voucher, VoucherEntry, VoucherType };

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ ledgers

/** Ledgers finance-kit adds to ledger-kit's chart (by system key). */
export const FINANCE_LEDGERS: { name: string; group: string; key: string }[] = [
  { name: "Collection Centre Share", group: "Direct Expenses", key: "partner_share" },
  { name: "Recoveries from Partners", group: "Indirect Incomes", key: "partner_recoveries" },
  { name: "TDS Payable", group: "Duties & Taxes", key: "tds_payable" },
  { name: "Cash Short / Excess", group: "Indirect Expenses", key: "cash_short_excess" },
  { name: "Bank Charges", group: "Indirect Expenses", key: "bank_charges" },
  { name: "Profit & Loss A/c", group: "Reserves & Surplus", key: "retained_earnings" },
];

/** ledger-kit's chart of accounts plus FINANCE_LEDGERS. Idempotent. */
export async function seedFinanceLedgers(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id): Promise<Ledger[]> {
  const { groups } = await seedChartOfAccounts(repos, orgId);
  const byName = new Map(groups.map((g) => [g.name, g]));
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    for (const l of FINANCE_LEDGERS) {
      if (await tx.ledgers.findBySystemKey(orgId, l.key)) continue;
      await tx.ledgers.create({ orgId, name: l.name, groupId: byName.get(l.group)!.id, openingPaise: 0, systemKey: l.key, active: true });
    }
    return tx.ledgers.find({ orgId });
  });
}

/** A party's own ledger (a B2B customer under Sundry Debtors, a partner under Sundry Creditors). */
export async function createPartyLedger(tx: Repositories, orgId: Id, name: string, group: "Sundry Debtors" | "Sundry Creditors"): Promise<Ledger> {
  const g = await tx.accountGroups.findOne({ orgId, name: group });
  if (!g) throw new ValidationError("Seed the chart of accounts first (seedFinanceLedgers)");
  return tx.ledgers.create({ orgId, name, groupId: g.id, openingPaise: 0, systemKey: null, active: true });
}

/** Ledger id by ledger-kit / finance system key. */
export async function ledgerId(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id, key: string): Promise<Id> {
  const l = await repos.ledgers.findBySystemKey(orgId, key);
  if (!l) throw new NotFoundError("Ledger with systemKey", `${key} (run seedFinanceLedgers)`);
  return l.id;
}

export async function ledgerIds<K extends string>(repos: Repositories, orgId: Id, keys: readonly K[]): Promise<Record<K, Id>> {
  const out = {} as Record<K, Id>;
  for (const k of keys) out[k] = await ledgerId(repos, orgId, k);
  return out;
}

/** The ledger a payment mode lands in (same mapping as ledger-kit's ledgerPostingHook). */
export const MODE_LEDGER: Record<PaymentMode, string> = {
  cash: "cash", upi: "upi", wallet: "upi", card: "card", netbanking: "bank", cheque: "bank", insurance: "bank",
};

/** Balance (+Dr) of a ledger, optionally one branch's postings only, up to an instant. */
export const balanceOf = (repos: Repositories, q: { orgId: Id; ledgerId: Id; branchId?: Id; asOf?: Date }) => ledgerBalance(repos, q);

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ posting

export interface PostInput {
  orgId: Id;
  branchId: Id;
  type: VoucherType;
  date: Date;
  narration?: string;
  entries: VoucherEntry[];
  invoiceId?: Id | null;
  paymentId?: Id | null;
}

/** One signed line: positive = debit, negative = credit, zero = dropped. */
export const line = (ledgerId: Id, signedPaise: number, invoiceId?: Id | null): VoucherEntry =>
  signedPaise >= 0 ? { ledgerId, debitPaise: signedPaise, creditPaise: 0, invoiceId: invoiceId ?? null } : { ledgerId, debitPaise: 0, creditPaise: -signedPaise, invoiceId: invoiceId ?? null };

/** Posts a balanced voucher (numbered, refused in a locked period). */
export function post(repos: Repositories, input: PostInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<Voucher> {
  return postVoucher(repos, input, actorId);
}

/** Cancels a voucher (refused in a locked period). */
export function cancel(repos: Repositories, voucherId: Id, actorId?: Id): Promise<Voucher> {
  return cancelVoucher(repos, voucherId, actorId);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the posting hook for db-kit's billing

/** The receivable ledger of an invoice: its B2B customer's, else Patient Receivables. */
export async function receivableLedger(tx: Repositories, invoice: Pick<Invoice, "orgId" | "customerId">): Promise<Id> {
  if (invoice.customerId) {
    const c = await tx.customers.get(invoice.customerId);
    if (!c || c.orgId !== invoice.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Customer", invoice.customerId);
    return c.ledgerId;
  }
  return ledgerId(tx, invoice.orgId, "receivables");
}

/** Sales voucher lines: tax split per line by place of supply; B2B invoices debit the customer's ledger. */
export async function salesEntries(tx: Repositories, invoice: Invoice): Promise<VoucherEntry[]> {
  const k = await ledgerIds(tx, invoice.orgId, ["sales", "discount", "round_off", "cgst", "sgst", "igst"] as const);
  const supply = await supplyResolver(tx)(invoice);
  const tax = invoiceTaxLines(invoice, supply.interState);
  const sum = (f: (l: (typeof tax)[number]) => number) => tax.reduce((s, l) => s + f(l), 0);
  const gross = invoice.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.amountPaise + i.discountPaise, 0);
  if (sum((l) => l.taxPaise) !== invoice.taxPaise) throw new ValidationError(`Invoice ${invoice.invoiceNo}: line taxes do not add up to its tax`);
  return [
    line(await receivableLedger(tx, invoice), invoice.totalPaise, invoice.id),
    line(k.discount, invoice.discountPaise),
    line(k.sales, -gross),
    line(k.cgst, -sum((l) => l.cgstPaise)),
    line(k.sgst, -sum((l) => l.sgstPaise)),
    line(k.igst, -sum((l) => l.igstPaise)),
    line(k.round_off, -invoice.roundOffPaise),
  ].filter((e) => e.debitPaise > 0 || e.creditPaise > 0);
}

/**
 * Pass to db-kit: `createDb({ ..., posting: financePosting })`. Invoices, payments and cancellations
 * then post through this module: GST split by place of supply, and B2B customers' own ledgers.
 * Needs the chart of accounts (seedFinanceLedgers).
 */
export const financePosting: PostingHook = {
  async invoiceIssued(tx, invoice, actorId) {
    await post(tx, {
      orgId: invoice.orgId, branchId: invoice.branchId, type: "sales", date: invoice.issuedAt ?? new Date(),
      narration: `Invoice ${invoice.invoiceNo}`, entries: await salesEntries(tx, invoice), invoiceId: invoice.id,
    }, actorId);
  },
  async paymentRecorded(tx, payment: Payment, invoiceNo, actorId) {
    const invoice = await tx.invoices.get(payment.invoiceId);
    if (!invoice) throw new NotFoundError("Invoice", payment.invoiceId);
    const money = await ledgerId(tx, payment.orgId, MODE_LEDGER[payment.mode]);
    const recv = await receivableLedger(tx, invoice);
    const sign = payment.kind === "refund" ? -1 : 1;
    await post(tx, {
      orgId: payment.orgId, branchId: payment.branchId, type: payment.kind === "refund" ? "payment" : "receipt", date: payment.receivedAt,
      narration: `${payment.kind === "refund" ? "Refund" : "Payment"} ${payment.mode.toUpperCase()} against ${invoiceNo}`,
      entries: [line(money, sign * payment.amountPaise), line(recv, -sign * payment.amountPaise, payment.invoiceId)],
      invoiceId: payment.invoiceId, paymentId: payment.id,
    }, actorId);
  },
  async invoiceCancelled(tx, invoiceId, actorId) {
    for (const v of await tx.vouchers.find({ invoiceId, type: "sales", status: "posted" })) await cancel(tx, v.id, actorId);
  },
};

/** finance-kit's workflows need its posting hook on the repositories. */
export function assertFinancePosting(repos: Repositories): void {
  if (repos.posting !== financePosting)
    throw new ValidationError("finance-kit needs its posting hook: createDb({ ..., posting: financePosting })");
}
```

## File: src/receivables/credit-notes.ts

```ts
import {
  ConflictError, financialYear, invoiceBalance, NotFoundError, ValidationError, type CreditNote, type CreditNoteLine, type Id, type Invoice,
  type Repositories,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { invoiceTaxLines, splitTax } from "../gst/breakup";
import { supplyResolver } from "../gst/supply";
import { assertFinancePosting, ledgerIds, line, post, receivableLedger } from "../posting";

export interface CreditNoteInput {
  orgId: Id;
  invoiceId: Id;
  reason: string;
  /**
   * Lines to credit by invoice item index, with the taxable value to take off (default: what is left
   * of that line). Omit `lines` to credit everything not yet credited.
   */
  lines?: { itemIndex: number; taxablePaise?: number }[];
  date?: Date;
}

export const creditNoteCounterKey = (orgId: Id, branchCode: string, fy: string) => `creditnote:${orgId}:${branchCode}:${fy}`;
/** "MGPL/RPR01/CN/2026-27/000001" */
export const formatCreditNoteNo = (orgCode: string, branchCode: string, fy: string, seq: number) => `${orgCode}/${branchCode}/CN/${fy}/${String(seq).padStart(6, "0")}`;

/**
 * Issues a GST credit note against an invoice (refund or price correction), in one transaction:
 * locks the invoice, computes each line's taxable value and tax (the last credit of a line takes
 * exactly what is left, so credits never exceed the invoice), numbers it, reduces what the invoice
 * owes, and posts a Credit Note voucher: Dr Sales, Dr Output GST, ± Round Off, Cr the receivable.
 * When the invoice was already paid, `refundablePaise` is what to refund (db-kit recordPayment, kind "refund").
 */
export async function issueCreditNote(repos: Repositories, input: CreditNoteInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<{ creditNote: CreditNote; invoice: Invoice; refundablePaise: number }> {
  assertFinancePosting(repos);
  if (!input.reason?.trim()) throw new ValidationError("A credit note needs a reason");
  const date = input.date ?? new Date();
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const inv = await tx.invoices.getForUpdate(input.invoiceId);
    if (!inv || inv.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Invoice", input.invoiceId);
    if (inv.status === "cancelled" || inv.status === "draft") throw new ConflictError(`Invoice ${inv.invoiceNo} is ${inv.status}`);
    if (inv.issuedAt && date.getTime() < inv.issuedAt.getTime()) throw new ValidationError("A credit note cannot be dated before its invoice");
    const supply = await supplyResolver(tx)(inv);
    const tax = invoiceTaxLines(inv, supply.interState);
    const previous = await tx.creditNotes.find({ invoiceId: inv.id, status: "issued" });
    const done = (idx: number, f: (l: CreditNoteLine) => number) => previous.flatMap((n) => n.lines).filter((l) => l.itemIndex === idx).reduce((s, l) => s + f(l), 0);

    const wanted: { itemIndex: number; taxablePaise?: number }[] = input.lines ?? tax.map((t) => ({ itemIndex: t.itemIndex }));
    if (new Set(wanted.map((w) => w.itemIndex)).size !== wanted.length) throw new ValidationError("Each invoice line may appear once");
    const lines: CreditNoteLine[] = [];
    for (const w of wanted) {
      const t = tax[w.itemIndex];
      if (!t) throw new ValidationError(`Invoice ${inv.invoiceNo} has no line ${w.itemIndex}`);
      const leftTaxable = t.taxablePaise - done(w.itemIndex, (l) => l.taxablePaise);
      const leftTax = t.taxPaise - done(w.itemIndex, (l) => l.taxPaise);
      if (leftTaxable <= 0) {
        if (input.lines) throw new ConflictError(`Line ${w.itemIndex} of ${inv.invoiceNo} is already fully credited`);
        continue;
      }
      const amount = w.taxablePaise ?? leftTaxable;
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(amount) || amount <= 0 || amount > leftTaxable) throw new ValidationError(`Line ${w.itemIndex}: credit 1–${leftTaxable} paise of taxable value`);
      const lineTax = amount === leftTaxable ? leftTax : Math.min(leftTax, Math.round((amount * t.ratePercent) / 100));
      lines.push({
        itemIndex: t.itemIndex, name: t.name, code: t.code, hsnSac: t.hsnSac || undefined, taxability: t.taxability, taxPercent: t.ratePercent,
        taxablePaise: amount, taxPaise: lineTax, ...splitTax(lineTax, supply.interState),
      });
    }
    if (!lines.length) throw new ConflictError(`Invoice ${inv.invoiceNo} is already fully credited`);

    const total = (f: (l: CreditNoteLine) => number) => lines.reduce((s, l) => s + f(l), 0);
    // when this note completes the invoice, it also reverses the invoice's round-off, so credits = invoice total
    const complete = tax.every((t) => t.taxablePaise - done(t.itemIndex, (l) => l.taxablePaise) - lines.filter((l) => l.itemIndex === t.itemIndex).reduce((s, l) => s + l.taxablePaise, 0) === 0);
    const roundOff = complete ? inv.roundOffPaise : 0;
    const totalPaise = total((l) => l.taxablePaise) + total((l) => l.taxPaise) + roundOff;

    const [org, branch] = await Promise.all([tx.orgs.get(inv.orgId), tx.branches.get(inv.branchId)]);
    const fy = financialYear(date);
    const seq = await tx.counters.next(creditNoteCounterKey(inv.orgId, branch!.code, fy));
    const k = await ledgerIds(tx, inv.orgId, ["sales", "cgst", "sgst", "igst", "round_off"] as const);
    const noteNo = formatCreditNoteNo(org!.code, branch!.code, fy, seq);
    const voucher = await post(tx, {
      orgId: inv.orgId, branchId: inv.branchId, type: "credit_note", date, invoiceId: inv.id,
      narration: `Credit note ${noteNo} against ${inv.invoiceNo}: ${input.reason.trim()}`,
      entries: [
        line(k.sales, total((l) => l.taxablePaise)),
        line(k.cgst, total((l) => l.cgstPaise)),
        line(k.sgst, total((l) => l.sgstPaise)),
        line(k.igst, total((l) => l.igstPaise)),
        line(k.round_off, roundOff),
        line(await receivableLedger(tx, inv), -totalPaise, inv.id),
      ].filter((e) => e.debitPaise > 0 || e.creditPaise > 0),
    }, actorId);
    const creditNote = await tx.creditNotes.create({
      orgId: inv.orgId, branchId: inv.branchId, invoiceId: inv.id, customerId: inv.customerId ?? null, noteNo, date, reason: input.reason.trim(), lines,
      taxablePaise: total((l) => l.taxablePaise), taxPaise: total((l) => l.taxPaise), cgstPaise: total((l) => l.cgstPaise), sgstPaise: total((l) => l.sgstPaise),
      igstPaise: total((l) => l.igstPaise), roundOffPaise: roundOff, totalPaise, placeOfSupply: supply.placeOfSupply, buyerGstin: inv.buyerGstin ?? null,
      voucherId: voucher.id, status: "issued", createdBy: actorId ?? null,
    });
    const credited = (inv.creditedPaise ?? 0) + totalPaise;
    const invoice = (await tx.invoices.update(inv.id, { creditedPaise: credited, ...invoiceBalance({ totalPaise: inv.totalPaise, creditedPaise: credited }, inv.paidPaise) }))!;
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: inv.orgId, branchId: inv.branchId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.credit_note.issue", entity: "credit_note", entityId: creditNote.id, data: { noteNo, invoiceNo: inv.invoiceNo, totalPaise } });
    return { creditNote, invoice, refundablePaise: Math.max(0, inv.paidPaise - (inv.totalPaise - credited)) };
  });
}
```

## File: src/receivables/customers.ts

```ts
import {
  computeTotals, ConflictError, issueInvoice, NotFoundError, ValidationError, type Address, type Customer, type CustomerKind, type Id, type Invoice,
  type IssueInvoiceInput, type Payment, type Repositories,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";
import { isValidGstin, placeOfSupply, stateOfGstin } from "../gst/place";
import { applyTaxRules } from "../gst/rules";
import { assertFinancePosting, balanceOf, createPartyLedger, ledgerStatement } from "../posting";
import { addDays, daysBetween, istDay } from "../util";

export interface CustomerInput {
  orgId: Id;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  kind: CustomerKind;
  legalName?: string;
  gstin?: string;
  stateCode?: string;
  pan?: string;
  phone?: string;
  email?: string;
  address?: Address;
  /** null or omitted = no limit. */
  creditLimitPaise?: number | null;
  creditDays?: number;
}

/** Thrown when a B2B invoice would take a customer over its credit limit. */
export class CreditLimitError extends ConflictError {
  constructor(customer: Customer, outstanding: number, amount: number) {
    super(`Credit limit of ${customer.code} exceeded: outstanding ${outstanding} + ${amount} > ${customer.creditLimitPaise} paise`);
    this.name = "CreditLimitError";
  }
}

function checkCustomer(c: Partial<CustomerInput>): void {
  if (c.gstin !== undefined && c.gstin !== "" && !isValidGstin(c.gstin)) throw new ValidationError(`Invalid GSTIN "${c.gstin}"`);
  if (c.stateCode !== undefined && !/^\d{2}$/.test(c.stateCode)) throw new ValidationError(`State code must be 2 digits: "${c.stateCode}"`);
  if (c.creditLimitPaise != null && !(Number.isSafeInteger(c.creditLimitPaise) && c.creditLimitPaise >= 0)) throw new ValidationError("creditLimitPaise must be whole paise ≥ 0");
  if (c.creditDays !== undefined && !(Number.isInteger(c.creditDays) && c.creditDays >= 0)) throw new ValidationError("creditDays must be a whole number ≥ 0");
}

/** Creates a B2B customer with its own ledger under Sundry Debtors. */
export async function createCustomer(repos: Repositories, input: CustomerInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<Customer> {
  checkCustomer(input);
  const code = input.code.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!/^[A-Z0-9_-]{2,32}$/.test(code)) throw new ValidationError(`Customer code must be 2–32 letters, digits, - or _: "${input.code}"`);
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    if (await tx.customers.findOne({ orgId: input.orgId, code })) throw new ConflictError(`Customer ${code} already exists`);
    const gstin = input.gstin ? input.gstin.trim().toUpperCase() : undefined;
    const ledger = await createPartyLedger(tx, input.orgId, `${input.name} [${code}]`, "Sundry Debtors");
    const customer = await tx.customers.create({
      ...input, code, gstin, stateCode: input.stateCode ?? stateOfGstin(gstin), creditLimitPaise: input.creditLimitPaise ?? null,
      creditDays: input.creditDays ?? 0, ledgerId: ledger.id, active: true,
    });
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId: input.orgId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.customer.create", entity: "customer", entityId: customer.id, data: { code } });
    return customer;
  });
}

export type CustomerUpdate = { orgId: Id; customerId: Id } & Partial<Omit<CustomerInput, "orgId" | "code">> & { active?: boolean };

/** Changes terms or details. The code and ledger stay. */
export async function updateCustomer(repos: Repositories, input: CustomerUpdate, actorId?: Id): Promise<Customer> {
  const { orgId, customerId, ...patch } = input;
  checkCustomer(patch);
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const c = await tx.customers.getForUpdate(customerId);
    if (!c || c.orgId !== orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Customer", customerId);
    const gstin = patch.gstin ? patch.gstin.trim().toUpperCase() : patch.gstin;
    const out = (await tx.customers.update(customerId, { ...patch, ...(gstin !== undefined ? { gstin, stateCode: patch.stateCode ?? stateOfGstin(gstin) } : {}) }))!;
    await tx.audit.log({ orgId, userId: actorId ?? null, action: "finance.customer.update", entity: "customer", entityId: customerId, data: { fields: Object.keys(patch) } });
    return out;
  });
}

export interface CustomerInvoiceInput extends Omit<IssueInvoiceInput, "customerId" | "placeOfSupply" | "buyerGstin"> {
  customerId: Id;
  /** Overrides the place of supply (state code). */
  placeOfSupply?: string;
  /** Fill GST from the tax rules (default true). */
  applyTaxRules?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Issues a B2B invoice: locks the customer, applies the GST rules, checks the credit limit against
 * the customer's ledger balance, and bills through db-kit's issueInvoice, all in one transaction.
 */
export async function issueCustomerInvoice(repos: Repositories, input: CustomerInvoiceInput, actorId?: Id): Promise<{ invoice: Invoice; payments: Payment[] }> {
  assertFinancePosting(repos);
  const date = input.date ?? new Date();
  return repos.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const customer = await tx.customers.getForUpdate(input.customerId);
    if (!customer || customer.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Customer", input.customerId);
    if (!customer.active) throw new ConflictError(`Customer ${customer.code} is inactive`);
    const [branch, org] = await Promise.all([tx.branches.get(input.branchId), tx.orgs.get(input.orgId)]);
    if (!branch || branch.orgId !== input.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Branch", input.branchId);
    const items = input.applyTaxRules === false ? input.items : await applyTaxRules(tx, input.orgId, input.items, date);
    const { totals } = computeTotals(items, input.billDiscountPaise);
    const paidNow = (input.payments ?? []).reduce((s, p) => s + p.amountPaise, 0);
    if (customer.creditLimitPaise !== null) {
      const outstanding = await balanceOf(tx, { orgId: input.orgId, ledgerId: customer.ledgerId });
      if (outstanding + totals.totalPaise - paidNow > customer.creditLimitPaise) throw new CreditLimitError(customer, outstanding, totals.totalPaise - paidNow);
    }
    const { applyTaxRules: _skip, ...rest } = input;
    return issueInvoice(tx, {
      ...rest, items, date, customerId: customer.id, buyerGstin: customer.gstin ?? null,
      placeOfSupply: placeOfSupply({ branch, org, customer, override: input.placeOfSupply }),
    }, actorId);
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ statements

export type AgeBucket = "not_due" | "1-30" | "31-60" | "61-90" | "90+";

export interface OpenItem {
  invoiceId: Id;
  invoiceNo: string;
  day: string;
  dueDay: string;
  totalPaise: number;
  paidPaise: number;
  creditedPaise: number;
  duePaise: number;
  /** Days past the due date (0 when not yet due). */
  overdueDays: number;
  bucket: AgeBucket;
}

const bucketOf = (overdue: number): AgeBucket => (overdue <= 0 ? "not_due" : overdue <= 30 ? "1-30" : overdue <= 60 ? "31-60" : overdue <= 90 ? "61-90" : "90+");

/**
 * A customer's statement for a period: opening balance, every posting with a running balance, closing
 * balance (from its ledger), plus open invoices aged by days past their due date at `to`.
 */
export async function customerStatement(repos: Repositories, q: { orgId: Id; customerId: Id; from: Date; to: Date }) {
  const customer = await repos.customers.get(q.customerId);
  if (!customer || customer.orgId !== q.orgId) throw new NotFoundError("Customer", q.customerId);
  const statement = await ledgerStatement(repos, { orgId: q.orgId, ledgerId: customer.ledgerId, from: q.from, to: q.to });
  const asOfDay = istDay(q.to);
  const invoices = await repos.invoices.listByDate({ orgId: q.orgId, customerId: customer.id, to: q.to });
  const open: OpenItem[] = invoices.filter((i) => i.duePaise > 0).map((i) => {
    const day = istDay(i.issuedAt ?? i.createdAt);
    const dueDay = addDays(day, customer.creditDays);
    const overdue = Math.max(0, daysBetween(dueDay, asOfDay));
    return {
      invoiceId: i.id, invoiceNo: i.invoiceNo, day, dueDay, totalPaise: i.totalPaise, paidPaise: i.paidPaise, creditedPaise: i.creditedPaise ?? 0,
      duePaise: i.duePaise, overdueDays: overdue, bucket: bucketOf(overdue),
    };
  });
  const ageing: Record<AgeBucket, number> = { not_due: 0, "1-30": 0, "31-60": 0, "61-90": 0, "90+": 0 };
  for (const o of open) ageing[o.bucket] += o.duePaise;
  const limit = customer.creditLimitPaise;
  return {
    customer,
    openingPaise: statement.openingPaise,
    rows: statement.rows,
    totalDebitPaise: statement.totalDebitPaise,
    totalCreditPaise: statement.totalCreditPaise,
    closingPaise: statement.closingPaise,
    open,
    ageing,
    openTotalPaise: open.reduce((s, o) => s + o.duePaise, 0),
    availableCreditPaise: limit === null ? null : limit - statement.closingPaise,
  };
}

/** Every customer's balance, overdue amount and ageing at an instant. */
export async function receivablesSummary(repos: Repositories, q: { orgId: Id; asOf: Date }) {
  const rows = [];
  for (const c of await repos.customers.find({ orgId: q.orgId }, { sort: { field: "code" } })) {
    const s = await customerStatement(repos, { orgId: q.orgId, customerId: c.id, from: q.asOf, to: q.asOf });
    rows.push({ customer: c, balancePaise: s.closingPaise, overduePaise: s.openTotalPaise - s.ageing.not_due, ageing: s.ageing });
  }
  return { rows, totalPaise: rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.balancePaise, 0) };
}
```

## File: src/util.ts

```ts
import { ValidationError } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/db-kit";

/**
 * Integer helpers. Money is integer paise; rates are basis points (1 bp = 0.01%) or GST percent.
 * Days are IST (Asia/Kolkata, UTC+5:30, no daylight saving) and written "YYYY-MM-DD".
 */

const IST_MS = 5.5 * 3600 * 1000;
const DAY_MS = 24 * 3600 * 1000;

/** Rounds a ratio n / d to the nearest integer, halves away from zero. Exact for safe integers. */
export function divRound(n: number, d: number): number {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(n) || !Number.isSafeInteger(d) || d <= 0) throw new ValidationError(`divRound needs safe integers (${n} / ${d})`);
  const q = Math.floor((2 * Math.abs(n) + d) / (2 * d));
  return n < 0 ? -q : q;
}

/** amount × bp / 10 000, rounded half away from zero. */
export const applyBp = (amountPaise: number, bp: number): number => divRound(amountPaise * bp, 10000);

/** Rounds paise to the nearest rupee, halves away from zero. */
export const roundToRupee = (paise: number): number => divRound(paise, 100) * 100;

/** "2026-10-14" for the IST calendar day of an instant. */
export function istDay(date: Date): string {
  return new Date(date.getTime() + IST_MS).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

const DAY_RE = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/;

export function assertDay(day: string): void {
  const m = DAY_RE.exec(day);
  if (!m || istDay(startOfDay(day, false)) !== day) throw new ValidationError(`Expected an IST day "YYYY-MM-DD", got "${day}"`);
}

function startOfDay(day: string, check = true): Date {
  if (check) assertDay(day);
  return new Date(Date.parse(`${day}T00:00:00.000Z`) - IST_MS);
}

/** 00:00:00.000 IST of a day. */
export const startOfIstDay = (day: string): Date => startOfDay(day);
/** 23:59:59.999 IST of a day: lock dates and day-end vouchers use it. */
export const endOfIstDay = (day: string): Date => new Date(startOfDay(day).getTime() + DAY_MS - 1);
/** The IST day `n` days after `day`. */
export const addDays = (day: string, n: number): string => istDay(new Date(startOfDay(day).getTime() + n * DAY_MS));
/** Whole days from `a` to `b` (IST days). */
export const daysBetween = (a: string, b: string): number => Math.round((startOfDay(b).getTime() - startOfDay(a).getTime()) / DAY_MS);

/** "2026-10" → first and last instant of that month in IST. */
export function monthRange(period: string): { from: Date; to: Date; first: string; last: string } {
  const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})$/.exec(period);
  if (!m || Number(m[2]) < 1 || Number(m[2]) > 12) throw new ValidationError(`Expected a month "YYYY-MM", got "${period}"`);
  const y = Number(m[1]);
  const mo = Number(m[2]);
  const first = `${period}-01`;
  const last = istDay(new Date(Date.UTC(mo === 12 ? y + 1 : y, mo === 12 ? 0 : mo, 1) - IST_MS - 1));
  return { from: startOfIstDay(first), to: endOfIstDay(last), first, last };
}

/** Indian financial year "2025-26" → 1 Apr 2025 00:00 IST … 31 Mar 2026 23:59:59.999 IST. */
export function fyRange(fy: string): { from: Date; to: Date; first: string; last: string } {
  const m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})$/.exec(fy);
  if (!m || (Number(m[1]) + 1) % 100 !== Number(m[2])) throw new ValidationError(`Expected a financial year like "2025-26", got "${fy}"`);
  const y = Number(m[1]);
  const first = `${y}-04-01`;
  const last = `${y + 1}-03-31`;
  return { from: startOfIstDay(first), to: endOfIstDay(last), first, last };
}

/** Financial year of an IST day or instant, e.g. "2026-27". */
export function fyOf(date: Date | string): string {
  const day = typeof date === "string" ? date : istDay(date);
  const y = Number(day.slice(0, 4));
  const start = Number(day.slice(5, 7)) >= 4 ? y : y - 1;
  return `${start}-${String((start + 1) % 100).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

export function assertPaise(value: number, what: string, { allowNegative = false } = {}): void {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || (!allowNegative && value < 0)) throw new ValidationError(`${what} must be whole paise${allowNegative ? "" : " (0 or more)"}: ${value}`);
}

export const sum = (xs: number[]): number => xs.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0);
```
